new_roles.title: Director, Enterprise Quality & Assurance
new_roles.description:
Requisition ID # 175673
 
 
**Job Category:** Compliance / Risk / Quality Assurance
 
**Job Level:** Director/Chief
 
**Business Unit:** Gen Counsel, Ethics, Risk & Compliance
 
**Work Type:** Hybrid
 
**Job Location:** Oakland
 
 
Position Summary
 
The Director of Enterprise Quality & Assurance will establish and lead the Enterprise Quality Management function under the Enterprise Risk & Compliance organization, providing an enterprise-wide framework to strengthen quality, promote consistent execution, and drive continuous improvement to PG&E’s Layers of Defense framework. Accountable for applying risk-informed assurance activities to increase confidence that operational processes and controls are effective and deliver intended safety, quality, compliance, and business outcomes. Plans, organizes, and directs assurance and quality management activities, leading staff and partnering with functional area coworkers to support PG&E’s collective success.
 
 
Reporting Relationship
 
This position reports to the Senior Director, Enterprise Assurance and will lead a team of 4 quality assurance professionals, both full-time employees and contractors. The Director will build the team as needed.
 
 
Job Responsibilities Defines enterprise-wide governance, standards, and performance measures to promote consistent execution, strengthen quality, and drive continuous improvement in partnership with functional leaders. Leads risk-informed assurance activities to increase confidence in operational process performance and risk management, with an initial focus on the Power Generation line of business. The Director will partner with asset, process, and risk owners to assess mitigation effectiveness and support executive-level communications. Applies a standardized, end-to-end work system framework to increase confidence in the performance of operational processes and controls that are designed and operating to manage risk and deliver intended safety, quality, compliance, and business outcomes. Serving as a trusted partner, leads assurance activities for PG&E’s operational processes and risks, including risk-related commitments, mitigation plans, and the use of risk models to inform work planning and operational decisions Partners with Internal Audit, Compliance, and Functional Area partners to strengthen PG&E’s Layers of Defense activities. Leads cross-functional teams to advance quality and process improvements, partnering with operational owners to implement corrective actions and applying follow-up assurance to assess their effectiveness Provides expert insight on operational risk, process performance, and quality management, translating assurance results into actionable recommendations for leaders and process owners. Produces reports and presentations that effectively communicate assurance findings, operational risk positions, quality trends, and improvement priorities, leveraging appropriate Lean tools and existing governance processes to support enhancing PG&E’s layers of defense framework.
 
 
Leadership Qualities
 
PG&E expects its leaders to conduct themselves with the highest ethics and integrity and to embody specific leadership qualities.
 
 
Strategic Mindset Seeing ahead to future possibilities and translating them into breakthrough strategies. Operating effectively, even when things are not certain or the way forward is not clear.
 
A Leader in the Community and Industry Effectively building formal and informal relationship networks inside and outside the organization. Anticipating and balancing the needs of multiple stakeholders.
 
Demonstrates Safety Leadership A safety champion in words and deeds with respect to both employee and public safety. Maintaining an environment of open dialog and free of retaliation.
 
Influences and Inspires Using various- communications that convey a clear understanding of the needs of different audiences. Maneuvering comfortably through complex policy, process, and people-related dynamics.
 
Optimizes Team Performance Building strong-identity teams that apply their diverse skills and perspectives to achieve common goals. Creating a climate where people are developed and motivated to do their best to help the organization.
 
Fiscally Responsible Interpreting and applying understanding of key financial indicators to make better business decisions. Planning and prioritizing work to meet commitments aligned with organizational goals.
 
Leads Ethically and in a Compliant Manner Sponsoring and sustaining a high integrity speak-up corporate culture which prioritizes ethics, safety and compliance. Building on necessary level of industry, company and subject-matter expertise, including laws and regulations.
 
Provides a High Level of Customer Service Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.
 
 
Background Qualifications
 
Minimum Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, or job-related discipline or equivalent experience 10 years of successful professional experience with utility operations management Proven track record of successful leadership experience, leading and developing strong teams
 
 
Desired Master’s Degree in Business, Finance or job-related discipline or equivalent experience Proven experience with Quality Management Systems Operational experience with Electric Operations, Gas Operations, Power Generation, Diablo Canyon Excellent communication skills and attitude necessary to establish and maintain positive working relationships with all management and personnel. Strong analytical and risk assessment skills
 
 
Compensation
 
PG&E is providing the salary range that the company in good faith believes it might pay for this position at the time of the job posting. This compensation range is specific to the locality of the job. The actual salary paid to an individual will be based on multiple factors, including, but not limited to, specific skills, education, licenses or certifications, experience, market value, geographic location, and internal equity.
 
 
We estimate the successful candidate hired into this role will be placed within the reasonable compensation range of $193K to $277K . The decision will be made on a case-by-case basis. This leadership role is also eligible for an annual Short Term Incentive Plan (STIP) award, as well as the Long Term Incentive Plan (LTIP) grant.

new_roles.title: Senior Director, Quality Assurance
new_roles.description:
Satsuma Pharmaceuticals is a biopharmaceutical company preparing to launch AtzumiTM (dihydroergotamine (DHE) nasal powder), a novel therapeutic product approved in the US for the acute treatment of migraine. AtzumiTM incorporates proprietary advanced powder and device technology (SMART – Simple MucoAdhesive Release Technology™) and is designed to be easy-to-use, easy-to-carry and for quick self-administration.

**Position Summary:**

Satsuma Pharmaceuticals is seeking an experienced, strategic leader to serve as Head of Quality Assurance. This individual will lead quality strategy and quality management systems through launch and early commercialization in the US. This role will oversee GxP quality activities across manufacturing, supply chain, distribution, quality systems, and vendor management to ensure inspection readiness and ongoing compliance. Furthermore, the Head of Quality Assurance will provide quality leadership for commercial launch readiness, including batch disposition, product release processes, complaint handling, deviations, CAPAs, change control, and product quality reviews. This is a critical leadership role responsible for scaling the quality organization to support the commercialization of Atzumiä (Dihydroergotamine) nasal powder and ensuring the highest standards of safety and efficacy. The successful candidate develops and provides quality strategy, vision, and direction across the organization, implementing company-wide GxP policies and practices and providing input to executive management, with decisions carrying long-term impact on the company's compliance posture and market success.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Build and maintain a scalable quality management system (QMS) that evolves from clinical-stage to commercial-readiness, ensuring compliance with FDA, ICH, and global GxP standards.
* Anticipate factors that could influence the company's quality strategy and market position, providing strategic direction across functional areas to support long-term compliance and business success.
* Establish and oversee robust commercial quality processes, including final product release/disposition, supply chain security, and distribution quality.
* Provide quality oversight for GLP, GCP, and GMP vendors; lead vendor qualifications, perform audits, and manage quality agreements with contract manufacturing and research organizations.
* Lead the management of deviations, CAPAs, change controls, and quality investigations, ensuring timely resolution and implementation of effective corrective actions.
* Proactively identify compliance risks and advise executive management on regulatory developments that impact company strategy.
* Apply persuasive, data-driven communication to influence executive decision-making on quality and regulatory strategy.
* Lead the development, implementation, and maintenance of GxP SOPs, policies, and controlled documents across all functional areas.
* Establish and manage the company-wide GxP training program for employees and consultants to foster a corporate culture of quality and compliance.
* Oversee commercial quality systems, including product complaint handling, adverse event reporting coordination, and annual product quality reviews (APQR).
* Partner with executive leadership to cascade company-wide quality policies and practices, ensuring consistent adoption and alignment with organizational goals.
* Lead and develop the quality organization through subordinate managers and team members, overseeing the successful execution of company-wide quality initiatives.
* Proactively identify, assume, and execute additional responsibilities, initiatives, and special projects as business needs evolve.

**Minimum Requirements Education/Experience:**

* A Bachelor of Science degree in a life science discipline (biology, chemistry, etc.) is required; an advanced degree is preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to develop and articulate company-wide quality strategy, vision, and direction, with the ability to anticipate emerging risks and their impact on business success.
* 10+ years of industry experience in Quality Assurance within the pharmaceutical or biotech sectors, with at least 8 years in a leadership role.
* Demonstrated success leading a quality function through a US commercial product launch and transitioning from clinical to commercial GxP requirements.
* Expert knowledge of US FDA GxP and ICH requirements; experience with European (EMA) or APAC regulations is highly desirable.
* Proven experience developing and implementing company-wide QMS platforms and managing complex quality investigations.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills with a "partnership approach" to working with cross-functional project teams and external partners.
* Ability to travel up to 30% (domestic and international) for vendor audits and site visits as required.
* Proven experience negotiating and influencing at the executive level, partnering with leadership to align quality strategy with organizational goals.

**Benefits and Pay:**

The expected salary range for this position is $230,000.00 - $270,000.00 USD. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, and other job-related factors permitted by law.

Satsuma Pharmaceuticals is committed to providing its employees with benefit options that are comprehensive, competitive, and that individual employees can tailor to their and their families’ specific needs. Eligible employees are offered Health Insurance, Dental & Vision Insurance, Healthcare & Dependent Care FSA, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), 401(k) Savings Plan, Long-term Incentive Plan, Life Insurance, Accident & Disability Insurance, Telemedicine, Generous Paid Time Off, and Company Holidays.

**EEO & Employment Eligibility:**

Satsuma Pharmaceuticals is committed to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive company. We provide equal opportunity in the terms and conditions of employment for all employees and job applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, gender identity or gender expression, national origin, disability, or veteran status. Satsuma Pharmaceuticals also complies with all applicable national, state, and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment as well as work authorization and employment eligibility verification required of applicable law.

new_roles.title: Senior Director, Technical Product Management — AI Quality & Evaluation
new_roles.description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*

Job Category

Product

Job Details

**About Salesforce**

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

**What You’ll Be Doing & Why It Matters** 
 
Help build the next generation of Agentforce. We’re an entrepreneurial incubation team within Salesforce, combining the pace and ownership of a startup with access to enterprise customers and Salesforce’s distribution. We’re looking for a technical product leader with deep AI expertise who wants to turn frontier capabilities into products customers can rely on.
 
 
Our team works closely with AI researchers, applied scientists, and engineers, uses coding agents extensively, and builds and experiments outside the core platform to iterate quickly. You’ll shape product strategy for AI quality and evaluation, establish how we measure progress, and personally lead a customer quality workstream and a focused feature from early learning through delivery.
 
 
This is a hands-on individual contributor leadership role, with an IC focus expected through 2027. You’ll lead through product ownership, technical judgment, and cross-functional influence while coaching colleagues, including junior designers and technical program managers. People-management responsibilities may develop as the product and team grow. You should enjoy inspecting traces and data, challenging evaluation results, prototyping with coding agents, and working directly with customers. Engineering partners own technical architecture and production implementation.
 
 
**Core Responsibilities & Scope**

* Set a coherent product strategy and roadmap for AI quality and evaluation, connecting customer needs, technical opportunities, and measurable business outcomes.
* Establish shared quality definitions, evaluation requirements, coverage priorities, and release criteria with research, engineering, and product partners.
* Make explicit investment tradeoffs across customer quality improvements, evaluation capabilities, and product features; align teams on priorities and decision ownership.
* Personally lead customer investigations and experiments. For example, investigate why an agent gives an incorrect answer or fails a tool-driven workflow, define the expected behavior, and partner with researchers and engineers to test a change and validate its customer impact.
* Build an operating approach that connects customer feedback, evaluation evidence, experiments, releases, and learning across teams.
* Partner with researchers, applied scientists, and engineers to design credible evaluations. Apply AI/ML fundamentals such as training/test separation, overfitting, representative coverage, and independent validation to assess non-deterministic model behavior and grader reliability.
* Lead delivery of capabilities that help customers understand and improve AI performance. For example, prototype an experience that turns a failed agent interaction into an evaluation case, makes the quality gap clear, and helps a customer verify whether a proposed change works.
* Coach product partners, junior designers, and technical program managers in problem framing, experimentation, and delivery; raise the quality of decisions through mentorship and practical example.
Bring verified competitive insight into strategy and communicate differentiation, limitations, and investment choices clearly to customers and senior stakeholders. 

**Minimum Requirements**

* A record of building AI/ML products and delivering measurable customer outcomes, with increasing ownership, scope, and impact.
* Deep hands-on experience building AI agents and evaluation capabilities in close partnership with AI researchers, applied scientists, or AI engineers. One to two years of substantive generative AI experience can be sufficient when supported by strong AI/ML fundamentals and demonstrated impact.
* Strong applied AI/ML judgment across model behavior, prompting, retrieval, agent/tool workflows, and the tradeoffs among model, data, system, and product improvements.
* Current hands-on ability to inspect data and traces, prototype with coding agents, and reason about experiments, overfitting, training/test splits, edge cases, and uncertainty. You can define what good looks like for a non-deterministic system and challenge conclusions with technical partners.
* Principled, flexible thinking: frame the underlying customer problem, test assumptions, and change direction when evidence warrants it. You can explain when lessons from a previous product apply and when the context demands a different approach.
* Experience establishing shared standards and resolving cross-team disagreements while preserving clear accountability and delivery momentum.
* Evidence of coaching and mentoring colleagues without relying on reporting authority, and the ability to deliver independently in a fast-moving environment.
Clear communication with customers, technical teams, and senior leaders, including an honest account of what is known, uncertain, or still unproven. 

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Evaluation platforms, agent systems, AI observability, retrieval, or enterprise AI products.
* Building in an AI-native startup or entrepreneurial environment, taking a new product from early customer learning to adoption, and applying lessons from both successful and unsuccessful experiments.
* Hands-on prototyping with coding agents and delivery of customer-facing performance or outcome experiences.
Leading initiatives that require agreement across research, engineering, product, and customer-facing organizations. 

What success looks like
 
 
Customers see credible improvement in real agent workflows, supported by evaluations they can trust. You independently take an initial quality problem from failure analysis through experimentation and customer validation, and deliver a focused feature with engineering. Teams make better release and investment decisions because of the evidence, product judgment, and coaching you bring.

Unleash Your Potential

new_roles.description:
**Everything we do is underscored by a why — and that why is one another.**

**Location:**

Altru Hospital,1200 South Columbia Road,Grand Forks, ND 58201

**Summary:**

The Director of Quality and Safety provides strategic leadership for organizational quality, patient safety, regulatory compliance, and performance improvement initiatives. This role partners with physicians, clinical leaders, and operational stakeholders to develop and implement programs that advance patient outcomes, ensure regulatory readiness, mitigate risk, and foster a culture of safety and continuous improvement. The Director oversees quality and safety operations, drives achievement of organizational and financial goals, ensures compliance with applicable regulatory standards, and leads the development of high-performing teams dedicated to delivering exceptional care and operational excellence. Through collaboration, innovation, and data-driven decision making, this position supports Altru's commitment to quality, safety, and outstanding patient experiences.
 
 
A master's degree and experience managing cross-functional teams including guiding clinical and administrative employees preferred

**Essential Job Functions:**

* Develops and implements long-range goals that enhance services and support strong relational management with key stakeholders. Develops collaborative relationships with leadership, physicians, clinical, professional and support staff. Sets standards for operational performance for the division/department(s) and fiscal accountability. Develops and achieves annual financial targets and holds managers and employees accountable to budget targets.
* Oversees the facilitation of regulatory requirements identified internally or from external agencies. Oversees the reporting and submission of regulatory compliance to external agencies as required through contractual relationships.
* Maintains competency in all organizational, department standards relevant to services provided.
* Practices process improvement principles and while managing processes to ensure all regulatory standards are met, and accesses internal resources to assist in adhering to standards as well as ensuring staff understand expectations
* Recruits, develops, retains and leads a talented team of leadership and staff committed to accomplishing the goals of Altru Health System. Builds an environment of shared commitment to organizational goals and fosters an environment conducive to maximizing individual and collective productivity, emphasizing performance and collaboration. Conducts performance reviews, actively recognizes and rewards employees and takes appropriate actions when performance is not meeting expectations. Acts as a mentor and promotes professional growth of employees. Takes responsibility for personal growth and development and meets all system educational requirements.
* Seeks out operational efficiency and involves employees and physicians in workforce redesign, as appropriate to better serve the patient, as well as create a workplace that all employees can function at their highest competency and productivity. Leads and participates in acquisition of new technologies to ensure the highest standard of care.
* Maintains competency in all organizational, department and outside agency standards relevant to services provided and ensures compliance. Manages processes to ensure all regulatory standards are met as well as works to prevent potential legal risk to Altru Health System as appropriate. Accesses internal resources to assist in adhering to standards as well as ensures staff understands expectations.
* Performs other duties as assigned or needed to meet the needs of the department/organization.

### **Certifications**

* Driver's License with Acceptable Driving Record | Driver's License - Current State Licensed | Prior to Start Date | HR Primary Sources

**Education:**

* Required: Bachelors - Business

**Work Experience:**

* Required: A minimum of 7 years Related Experience

**Language Requirements:**

This position requires proficiency in reading, writing, and speaking English to ensure effective communication in the workplace and with patients, families, and team members.

* Sit: Frequently (34-66%)

* Stand: Occasionally (5-33%)

* Walk: Frequently (34-66%)

* Carry: Sedentary (<10 pounds)

* Indoor: Continuously (67-100%)

* **Professional Drivers:** Persons who drive as their main responsibility OR transport passengers or hazardous materials.
* **Frequent Drivers:** Persons whose main responsibility is not driving, but drive daily or almost daily.
* **Occasional Drivers** : Persons who drive from once per month to as frequently as once per week.
* **Infrequent Drivers:** Persons who are generally not expected to drive.

Infrequent DriverReference ID: R8492

To take the best care of our patients and community — including friends, family, and neighbors — we need people who are committed to growth, excellence, and one another.

At Altru, you’ll find a culture where support and teamwork are at the heart of what we do. You’ll have opportunities to advance your skills, work with the latest technologies, experience the fulfillment that comes from giving back, and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join our team and be a part of a small community with a big heart.

With our three market leading businesses, world-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world.

 

**Pratt & Whitne**y is a world leader in the design, manufacture and service of aircraft engines and auxiliary power systems and has been revolutionizing modern flight for over 100 years. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

Quality Director, Columbus Engine Center

**What You Will Do:**

* As the Quality Director for the Columbus Engine Center, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring a "quality-first" culture within a large, dynamic organization. You will lead strategic initiatives to enhance product safety, compliance, and operational excellence, while fostering a culture of accountability and continuous improvement. Your responsibilities will include:
* Providing strategic leadership for all Quality Assurance, Quality Control, and inspection activities across the Columbus Engine Center.
* Collaborating with Operations, Engineering, and Materials teams to ensure robust processes, effective change management, and prevention-based quality measures.
* Championing product safety through operational discipline and continuous improvement on the shop floor.
* Overseeing critical compliance programs, including training, records management, audits (internal, regulator, and customer), procedures, and major investigations.
* Monitoring and reporting on key quality metrics, developing action plans to achieve organizational goals.
* Ensuring adherence to AS9100, FAA, DCMA, and customer-specific quality requirements.
* Leading root cause analysis, corrective actions, and continuous improvement initiatives using CORE tools.
* Driving process capability improvements, defect reduction, and first-pass yield enhancements through data-driven decision-making.
* Managing nonconforming material, Material Review Board (MRB) processes, and risk assessments for critical aerospace components.

**Qualifications You Must Have**:

* Bachelor’s degree and 14 years of experience, or 12 years of experience with an Advanced degree.
* Experience in Quality Management within the Aerospace or other highly regulated manufacturing industry.
* Senior leadership or people management experience.
* Experience in Operations, Quality, or Engineering within the Aerospace manufacturing industry.

**Qualifications We Prefer**:

* 5+ years of experience in Operations Leadership.
* Experience leading organizations and other leaders.
* Aftermarket Aerospace / Maintenance, Repair, and Overhaul (MRO) experience.
* Familiarity with FAR-145 / CFR-145 Repair Station operations.
* Knowledge of FAA regulatory compliance.
* Background in Engineering.
* Airframe & Powerplant (A&P) Certification.
* Experience with SAP Quality systems.
* Understanding of AS9100 and Quality Management Systems (QMS).

Learn More & Apply Now!

new_roles.title: Director, Quality Engineering
new_roles.description:
**Become a part of our caring community**
=========================================

Humana is committed to helping people achieve their best health by delivering innovative technology solutions that enable exceptional member and provider experiences. 
The Director, Quality Engineering – Test Data Management (EQE) is a senior technology leader responsible for defining, advancing, and operating Humana's enterprise Test Data Management (TDM) function within Enterprise Quality Engineering. Reporting to the VP, Quality Engineering, this role leads the strategy, operating model, and execution of secure, scalable, compliant, and automation-enabled test data capabilities that support software delivery across Humana's business and technology organizations. 
This leader is accountable for building and leading a high-performing organization responsible for core TDM services, including test data provisioning, synthetic data generation, masking, de-identification, data lifecycle management, and environment data coordination. The Director will partner closely with Quality Engineering, Engineering, Product, Architecture, DevOps, Infrastructure, Security, Privacy, Risk, and Data teams to ensure test data is available, fit for purpose, and aligned to delivery, compliance, and release readiness needs. 
The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in test data management, data engineering, governance, privacy, and automation in a complex enterprise environment. This role will drive modernization of TDM practices through automation-first and AI-enabled capabilities, while establishing standards, controls, and reusable services that improve engineering throughput, reduce delivery friction, and strengthen compliance and data protection across non-production environments.

**Responsibilities**

**Leadership, Strategy & Operating Model**

* Lead the enterprise Test Data Management function within EQE, including strategic direction, operating model execution, and organizational development.
* Build, lead, and develop a high-performing team of managers, engineers, and test data specialists across multiple groups supporting segment and enterprise needs.
* Oversee a distributed organization of **50+ associates** and create clear priorities, role clarity, and performance expectations.
* Partner with Quality Engineering, Engineering, Product, Architecture, DevOps, Infrastructure, Security, and Data teams to align TDM services with business and delivery priorities.
* Drive a scalable support model for segment TDM services across multiple portfolios and delivery teams.
* Promote a culture of quality, compliance, continuous improvement, and shared ownership of secure test data practices.

**Test Data Engineering & Management**

 

* Lead enterprise engineering and management of secure, scalable, and compliant test data solutions.
* Oversee delivery of core TDM capabilities, including:Test data provisioningSynthetic data generationData masking and obfuscationData de-identificationData quality enablementTest data automationData lifecycle managementEnvironment data coordination
* Ensure test data is available, fit for purpose, and aligned to quality engineering, release, and environment needs.
* Advance data engineering practices that improve the reliability, reusability, and speed of test data provisioning across delivery pipelines.
* Support complex testing needs across functional, integration, regression, end-to-end, and non-production validation use cases.

**AI-Enabled & Automation-First TDM**

 

* Drive **AI-enabled** and automation-first TDM strategies to improve speed, intelligence, scalability, and coverage of test data operations.
* Expand the use of AI and advanced automation for synthetic data generation, sensitive data detection, masking rule optimization, provisioning efficiency, and data quality insights.
* Integrate TDM automation into CI/CD and engineering workflows where applicable to reduce manual effort and increase release confidence.
* Partner with enterprise engineering and platform teams to modernize TDM tooling, workflows, and reusable patterns.
* Establish metrics to evaluate automation effectiveness, data readiness, cycle time reduction, and business value realization.

**Governance, Standards, Compliance & Privacy**

 

* Define and enforce enterprise TDM standards, governance, and operating policies.
* Ensure compliance with privacy, security, and regulatory requirements related to test data usage, storage, movement, masking, and de-identification.
* Oversee implementation of compliance and privacy controls for non-production data usage.
* Establish standards for secure handling of production-like data in test environments.
* Partner with security, risk, privacy, and compliance stakeholders to maintain appropriate controls and audit readiness.
* Promote consistent governance for test data access, retention, refresh, lineage, and lifecycle management.

**Delivery Enablement & Stakeholder Partnership**

 

* Enable delivery teams through timely, compliant, and high-quality test data services that improve engineering throughput and release readiness.
* Partner with segment quality engineering leaders and application teams to understand demand patterns and align TDM support to delivery roadmaps.
* Coordinate across environments and shared services to reduce delays related to data setup, refresh, and availability.
* Influence engineering and quality practices that improve testability, environment readiness, and quality outcomes.
* Collaborate with enterprise enablement and platform teams to standardize capabilities and reduce duplication.

**Metrics, Governance & Continuous Improvement**

 

* Define and monitor KPIs related to test data availability, provisioning speed, automation adoption, compliance adherence, data quality, and operational efficiency.
* Use data and insights to identify risks, bottlenecks, and improvement opportunities across TDM services.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to reduce manual work, increase data reliability, and improve customer satisfaction.
* Provide clear reporting and operational transparency to senior leadership and stakeholders.
* Build maturity roadmaps for enterprise TDM capabilities and measure progress against defined outcomes.

**Use your skills to make an impact**
=====================================

**Required Qualifications**

 

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or any technology related degree or equivalent experience.
* **10+ years** of experience in quality engineering, test data management, data engineering, software engineering, or related technical disciplines.
* **5+ years** of leadership experience managing enterprise-scale technology teams, including managers and geographically distributed associates.
* Experience leading or scaling **test data management**, data engineering, or quality engineering functions in a large enterprise environment.
* Demonstrated success building and operating secure, scalable, and compliant test data solutions.
* Experience with key TDM capabilities such as data provisioning, masking, obfuscation, de-identification, synthetic data generation, and lifecycle management.
* Strong understanding of privacy, security, and compliance considerations for test data in regulated environments.
* Experience driving automation and process modernization across engineering or quality workflows.
* Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills, with the ability to influence across engineering, quality, data, and business organizations.
* Experience working in Agile and DevOps environments and supporting modern software delivery practices.

**Preferred Qualifications**

 

* Experience in healthcare, payer/insurance, or another highly regulated industry.
* Experience supporting enterprise quality engineering or platform enablement organizations.
* Familiarity with test data management platforms, masking tools, synthetic data solutions, and data quality tooling.
* Knowledge of cloud platforms, distributed systems, APIs, CI/CD pipelines, and enterprise engineering platforms.
* Experience applying AI or machine learning capabilities to test data, quality engineering, or operational optimization.
* Familiarity with data governance, data retention, and environment management practices in large-scale enterprises.

**Success in this Role**

In this role, success will be measured by:

* Improved speed, reliability, and scalability of enterprise test data provisioning and support.
* Increased adoption of secure, compliant, and reusable TDM solutions across segments and teams.
* Reduced delivery delays caused by test data availability, quality, or environment coordination issues.
* Strong compliance with privacy, security, masking, and de-identification requirements.
* Measurable advancement in AI-enabled and automation-first TDM capabilities.
* Improved stakeholder satisfaction across Quality Engineering, Engineering, Product, and Delivery teams.
* Strong associate engagement, capability growth, and retention across the TDM organization.

In certain roles, the minimum recommended internet speed required by Humana may not be sufficient for business needs. Humana reserves the right to require associates to upgrade their internet service if necessary. Work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information. 
Travel: While this is a remote position, occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required.

**Scheduled Weekly Hours**

40

**Pay Range**

The compensation range below reflects a good faith estimate of starting base pay for full time (40 hours per week) employment at the time of posting. This job is eligible for a bonus incentive plan. This incentive opportunity is based upon company and/or individual performance.

**Description of Benefits**

Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole-person well-being. Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. Among our benefits, Humana provides medical, dental and vision benefits, 401(k) retirement savings plan, time off (including paid time off, company and personal holidays, paid parental and caregiver leave), short-term and long-term disability, life insurance and many other opportunities.

**About us**
============

Through our Humana insurance services and our CenterWell healthcare services, we make it easier for the millions of people we serve to achieve their best health – delivering the care and service they need, when they need it. These efforts are leading to a better quality of life for people with Medicare and Medicaid, families, individuals, military service personnel, and communities at large. Learn more about what we offer at Humana.com and at CenterWell.com.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

It is the policy of Humana not to discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, genetic information, disability or protected veteran status. It is also the policy of Humana to take affirmative action, in compliance with Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act and VEVRAA, to employ and to advance in employment individuals with disability or protected veteran status, and to base all employment decisions only on valid job requirements. This policy shall apply to all employment actions, including but not limited to recruitment, hiring, upgrading, promotion, transfer, demotion, layoff, recall, termination, rates of pay or other forms of compensation and selection for training, including apprenticeship, at all levels of employment.

new_roles.description:
**A Brief Overview** 
The Director of Quality, Safety, Accreditation and Policy provides strategic and operational leadership for clinical 
quality, patient safety, regulatory readiness, accreditation compliance, and organizational policy management 
across a large, complex medical center. The Director establishes priorities, ensures alignment across clinical and 
operational functions, and partners with physician, nursing, operational, and administrative executives to 
advance high reliability, continuous improvement, regulatory excellence, and patient-centered care. This position 
has accountability for the design, execution, and sustained performance of quality improvement, patient safety, 
accreditation, policy governance, performance measurement, and regulatory compliance programs. The Director 
translates organizational strategy into medical center-wide priorities, evaluates performance and risk, directs 
corrective action, and provides executive leaders with recommendations needed to achieve organizational goals 
and external standards. 
What You Will Do 

* Quality and Performance Improvement
* Establish and lead the organization's quality, safety, accreditation, and policy strategy in alignment with

organizational strategy and medical center priorities. 

* Set the performance improvement agenda and direct organization-wide and departmental initiatives,

including prioritization, resource allocation, accountability, and sustainability of results. 

* Establish performance expectations and governance for key quality indicators, publicly reported

measures, regulatory metrics, and improvement commitments; intervene when performance or 
compliance is at risk. 

* Facilitate data-driven improvement efforts using Lean, Six Sigma, PDSA, and other improvement

methodologies. 

* Own the integrity, interpretation, and executive communication of quality dashboards, scorecards, and

performance reporting, including recommendations for action and escalation. 

* Partner with physician and nursing leaders to improve clinical outcomes, reliability, equity, and patient

experience. 

* Exercise decision-making authority within the assigned portfolio and escalate material quality, safety,

regulatory, or accreditation risks to executive leadership and appropriate governance bodies. 

* Define accountability structures for leaders responsible for performance improvement plans and verify

that corrective actions produce sustained results. 

* Patient Safety
* Provide leadership for the patient safety program and establish expectations for a culture of safety, high

reliability, transparency, learning, and accountability 

* Direct governance for event reporting, root cause analyses, apparent cause analyses, and corrective

action plans; ensure timely escalation, leadership accountability, and validation that risk-reduction 
actions are effective and sustained. 

* In partnership with Risk and clinical loss control, monitor serious safety events, near misses, and highreliability

metrics. 

* Collaborate with risk management, infection prevention, and operational leaders on safety priorities.
* Integrate patient safety, infection prevention, clinical risk, quality improvement, and regulatory priorities

to reduce duplication, close gaps, and promote consistent practices across care settings. 

* Support implementation of evidence-based practices to reduce preventable harm.
* Accreditation and Regulatory Compliance
* Provide oversight of Joint Commission, DNV, CMS, state, and specialty accreditation readiness,

partnering with the designated accreditation leader who directs day-to-day readiness activities to include 
establishing priorities, assigning corrective actions, and escalating unresolved compliance risks. 

* Oversee organizational responses to survey findings and regulatory deficiencies, including corrective

action governance, evidence submission, validation of sustained compliance, and executive escalation; 
monitor regulatory changes and communicate implications to leadership; and partner with operational 
leaders to address gaps and sustain compliance. 

* Policy Management and Governance
* Lead policy governance and document control processes including standards for development, approval,

publication, review, exception management, and retirement. 

* Ensure policies remain current, evidence-based, and aligned with regulatory requirements.
* Coordinate policy review cycles and approvals with clinical, operational, legal, compliance, and executive

stakeholders.

Evaluate policy compliance trends and identify improvement opportunities. 

* Resolve or escalate cross-functional policy conflicts and ensure accountable leaders address material

gaps in policy implementation or adherence. 

* Maintain oversight of organizational policy standards and publication processes. Consistent with UH

policy governance structures, accreditation, compliance, legal, quality, and operational leaders 
collaborate to ensure policy adherence and regulatory alignment. 

* Academic Mission Support
* Collaborate with medical school leadership, residency and fellowship programs, and research leadership

to integrate quality, safety, and regulatory expectations into organizational programs. 

* Support quality and safety education for medical students, residents, fellows, and faculty.
* Leadership and Operations
* Establish departmental goals, operating plans, budgets, staffing models, and resource priorities; monitor

financial and operational performance and adjust plans as organizational needs change. 

* Build leadership capability and succession plans for quality, safety, accreditation, regulatory, policy, and

performance improvement professionals; hold direct reports accountable for measurable outcomes. 

* Serve as the quality and safety advisor to executive, physician, nursing, and operational leadership,

providing independent evaluation of performance, risk, regulatory exposure, and improvement priorities. 

* Present quality, safety, accreditation, regulatory, and policy performance to governing boards, executive

committees, and medical staff leadership; recommend decisions, investments, and corrective actions. 

* Chair or lead multidisciplinary governance committees focused on quality, accreditation, safety,

regulatory compliance, and policy, with authority to establish agendas, assign accountability, and 
escalate unresolved issues. 

* Negotiate priorities and resource needs across competing operational demands while protecting

regulatory compliance, patient safety, and organizational performance. 

* Represent the medical center in organization-wide councils and, as assigned, with external regulators,

accrediting organizations, professional associations, and community partners.

**Additional Responsibilities** 

* Performs other duties as assigned.
* Complies with all policies and standards.
* For specific duties and responsibilities, refer to documentation provided by the department during

orientation. 

* Must abide by all requirements to safely and securely maintain Protected Health Information (PHI) for

our patients. Annual training, the UH Code of Conduct and UH policies and procedures are in place to 
address appropriate use of PHI in the workplace.

**Education Qualifications** 

* Bachelor's Degree in Healthcare Administration, Nursing, Public Health, Business Administration, or

related field (Required) 

* Master's Degree in Healthcare Administration, Nursing, Public Health, Business Administration, or related

field Preferred (Preferred)

**Experience Qualifications** 

* 8+ years of experience in healthcare quality, patient safety, accreditation, regulatory, and clinical

leadership experience with several years in people management capacity[ (Required) 

* Experience within an academic medical center, integrated delivery system, or large healthcare

organization. (Required) 
• • Experience with Joint Commission/DNV survey leadership. • Experience overseeing policy governance. 

* Experience leading multidisciplinary teams, influencing senior and executive leaders, managing

organizational change, and sustaining measurable results across complex operations. • Experience 
presenting to governing boards, executive committees, medical staff leadership, or comparable senior 
governance groups. • Experience managing budgets, staffing plans, and resource allocation for a 
complex function or department. (Preferred

**Licenses and Certifications** 
• • Certified Professional in Healthcare Quality (CPHQ) • Certified Professional in Patient Safety (CPPS) • 
Lean Six Sigma Green Belt, Black Belt, or equivalent • Healthcare accreditation or regulatory certification 
(Preferred)

**Physical Demands**

new_roles.title: Director of Quality
new_roles.description:
**Company Overview**

Red 6 is an innovative Augmented Reality (AR) technology startup leading the way in synthetic air combat training. Our primary technology, supporting our ATARS product, enables pilots to simulate the cognitive challenges of flying while accessing realistic, scalable training in dynamic outdoor environments.

**Director of Quality**

Lead Red 6 into a scalable aerospace product organization.

Red 6 develops advanced augmented reality capabilities for aerospace and defense applications. We seek a hands-on, strategic Director of Quality to lead the next phase of our evolution into disciplined, repeatable product qualification and production. This leader will strengthen existing foundations while guiding the processes, evidence, and behaviors needed to meet customer, regulatory, safety, and aerospace industry expectations.

Success requires more than maintaining certifications. The Director will embed quality planning into product development, improve manufacturing and supplier readiness, and create a culture in which teams jointly solve problems before they become defects, delays, or compliance findings. Key results are building practical, auditable quality processes with Quality as a trusted partner across Engineering, Operations, Programs, and the supplier base.

**WHAT YOU WILL LEAD**

* Own the enterprise Quality strategy and roadmap, scaling the Quality Management System (QMS) to match product maturity, production volume, and customer commitments.
* Maintain and continuously improve AS9100 certification and audit readiness. Lead management reviews, internal audits, corrective action effectiveness, risk based thinking, and process ownership.
* Lead ISO 45001 occupational health and safety management system maturation and certification readiness, in coordination with accountable safety and operations leaders.
* Deploy practical Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP) disciplines aligned to AS9145 where applicable, including quality planning, process flow, PFMEA, control plans, measurement system analysis, first article inspection, and production readiness reviews.
* Integrate Quality into design inputs, reviews, verification and validation, configuration control, design changes, manufacturing transitions, and product release criteria.
* Establish scalable document and record controls, product pedigree, serial level traceability, inspection and test evidence, nonconformance controls, material review, CAPA, and calibration systems.
* Develop supplier qualification, surveillance, performance scorecards, supplier corrective actions, and risk based oversight of contract manufacturers and critical suppliers.
* Partner with Engineering and Operations to strengthen hardware quality, reliability, manufacturability, process validation, FOD/ESD controls, and handling of nonconforming material.
* Improve the connection between Windchill PLM, Epsilon3 MES, Unanet ERP, and existing compliance tools to support controlled, usable, auditable data across design, build, and delivery.
* Lead customer quality engagement, audits, contractual quality deliverables, and coordination with defense and aerospace stakeholders as applicable.

**LEAD A COLLABORATIVE QUALITY CULTURE**

* Build a capable Quality team with clear roles, coaching, succession planning, and cross functional influence.
* Act as a constructive partner to Engineering. Translate standards and contractual obligations into design intent, risk, and measurable acceptance criteria rather than relying on clause citations alone.
* Distinguish nonnegotiable compliance outcomes from implementation choices. Invite Engineering and Operations to co-design efficient solutions.
* Create early quality engagement in program planning and design reviews. Resolve disagreements using evidence, risk, cost, schedule, and accountable decision ownership.
* Establish shared performance measures and a regular Quality–Engineering working cadence to reduce late surprises and unproductive escalation.
* Promote a just, learning oriented culture that encourages timely issue reporting, root cause analysis, and effective preventive action.

**QUALIFICATIONS REQUIRED**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Significant progressive aerospace or defense quality leadership experience, including building or scaling an AS9100 QMS and leading certification or surveillance audits.
* Demonstrated success moving products from prototype or development environments into qualified, controlled, repeatable production.
* Working knowledge of APQP per AS9145, AS9102 first article inspection, supplier quality, configuration management, CAPA, and risk based process control.
* Ability to influence senior technical leaders without defaulting to authority or unnecessary bureaucracy. Strong facilitation, coaching, and conflict resolution skills.
* Experience with customer and supplier quality requirements, quality metrics, and cross functional improvement programs.

* Ability to work on site in Denver and travel periodically to suppliers and other Red 6 locations.
* Must be US Citizen to have the ability to obtain and maintain a DoD Security Clearance.

**PREFERRED EXPERIENCE**

* ISO 45001 implementation or certification leadership; AS9115 awareness for deliverable software where relevant.
* DoD prime contractor interfaces, DCMA, DFARS, and applicable government customer quality requirements.
* Experience with PLM, MES, ERP, and integrated digital quality workflows, especially Windchill, Epsilon3, and Unanet.
* Lean Six Sigma, ASQ quality credentials, GD&T, hardware reliability, and complex electromechanical systems.
* Experience developing small teams into mature, business enabling quality organizations.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN THE FIRST 12 MONTHS**

* Publish an agreed risk based Quality maturity roadmap with clear process owners and milestones.
* Sustain AS9100 compliance and close systemic audit or corrective action gaps with evidence of effectiveness.
* Introduce an appropriate APQP and production readiness framework for priority product lines.
* Improve supplier quality visibility, product traceability, and readiness of controlled manufacturing documentation.
* Demonstrate stronger Quality–Engineering collaboration through earlier issue resolution and fewer late stage quality surprises.
* Provide leadership with a concise scorecard covering escapes, rework, supplier performance, CAPA aging, audit findings, and readiness milestones.

Estimated Base Salary range dependent on skills and experience: $175,000 to $195,000

**Full-Time Employee Benefits**

* Healthcare, Dental, and Vision (100% coverage for Employees)
* Paid time off, including vacation, sick, paid holidays, and parental leave
* Short and Long-Term Disability
* Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
* 401(k) Retirement Plan
* Voluntary Worksite Benefits (Accident, Critical Illness, and Hospital Indemnity)
* May be eligible for a discretionary annual bonus based on individual and company performance, subject to plan terms.

**Note**

Red 6 reserves the right to change its current benefits program at any time, in a manner that is consistent with applicable federal and state regulations.

new_roles.title: Director, Evaluation and Quality Assurance, Services Special Projects
new_roles.description:
Summary
 
 
We are looking for a Director to build and lead the evaluation and quality assurance function for one of our most ambitious multi-year engineering initiatives. This is a true 0-to-1, first-key-hire role: There is no existing team, tooling, or process to inherit. You will define how we measure quality across an entire product end to end, build the automation and evaluation infrastructure to do it at scale (or borrow other teams' infrastructure), and build and lead the organization that runs it.
 
 
Description
 
 
You will own evaluation and quality assurance for every layer of the product — from whether the system is being correctly triggered for the right set of user requests, through whether it surfaces and ranks the right results, to whether the underlying transactions execute correctly, including integrations with external partner APIs, and financial systems. Quality here isn't a single test suite — it spans conversational understanding, relevance and ranking, and revenue-bearing correctness, all against a large, constantly evolving real-world dataset. You will create and drive the evaluation and quality strategy and implementation for the product. This will extensively utilize automated grading systems and human evaluation programs where appropriate. You will make the calls about where to invest in each. You will define what "correct" and "good" mean for this product, wire that definition into continuous, always-on evaluation pipelines with clear pass/fail quality gates tied to releases, and build the team, tooling, and operating rhythm to catch issues before they reach users. As the first hire in this space, you will operate with significant latitude and ambiguity — setting strategy, process, and technical direction with minimal existing scaffolding, while also building and scaling an organization. You will partner closely with engineering, applied ML, and program management leadership, including senior executive stakeholders, and you will be a key voice in defining what "done" and "shippable" mean for a product still taking shape, as well as iterating on decision points in production after the product ships.
 
 
Minimum Qualifications 
 
 

* 12+ years of experience in data science, machine learning evaluation, quality assurance, or test engineering roles in a technical product environment, including experience building and leading multi-level QA or evaluation organizations through managers.
* Demonstrated experience building an evaluation or QA function from the ground up — defining metrics, process, tooling, and organizational structure where none previously existed.
* Extensive experience utilizing LLM-based autograders and rubrics, including rubric design, evaluation set development, validation, calibration, and human-model alignment, and using them to proactively drive product and model improvements.
* Deep experience in traditional human evaluation methodology, logging, and A/B testing for consumer-facing products at scale.
* Experience evaluating conversational AI, recommendation, ranking, or search systems, and — ideally — agentic or tool-use systems that take real-world actions, not just generate responses.
* BS in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.
* Experience with quality assurance for third-party API integrations.
* Experience with logging infrastructure and instrumentation for AI product quality measurement.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of presenting quality status, risk, and trade-offs clearly to, and influencing decisions among, senior executive leadership.

 
 
 
Preferred Qualifications 
 
 

* 15+ years of experience in data science, machine learning evaluation, quality assurance, or test engineering roles in a technical product environment, including experience building and leading multi-level QA or evaluation organizations through managers.

The base pay range for this role is between $311,100 and $496,900, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. 
 
Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple’s discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple’s Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You’ll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses — including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. Learn more about Apple Benefits

We seek to promote equal opportunity for all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, Veteran status, or other legally protected characteristics. Learn more about your EEO rights as an applicant

new_roles.description:
California, US residents .

**The job details are as follows:**

Who We Are

We are the first publicly-traded biotech or pharmaceutical company to take the form of a public benefit corporation. Our public benefit purpose is to provide a brighter future for patients through the development of novel pharmaceutical therapies; and technologies that expand the availability of transplantable organs.

United Therapeutics (Nasdaq: UTHR) seeks to travel down the corridors of indifference to develop treatments for rare, deadly diseases. We were founded in 1996 by a family seeking a cure for their daughter’s pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH). Today, we have six FDA-approved therapies that treat PAH, pulmonary hypertension associated with interstitial lung disease (PH-ILD) and neuroblastoma, a rare pediatric cancer. Our near-term pipeline seeks to develop additional therapies for PAH and pulmonary fibrosis (PF).

The cure for end-stage life-threatening diseases like PAH, PH-ILD, PF, and many others is an organ transplant, but only a small percentage of donated organs are available to address the vast need. For this reason, we are working to create manufactured organs to address the shortage of kidneys, hearts, lungs, and livers available for transplant. We believe an unlimited supply of tolerable, transplantable organs will eliminate the transplant waiting list and cure end-stage organ diseases for which transplant is not currently an option. 
 
Who You Are

You’ll help define what “right first time” means in one of the most ambitious frontiers of modern medicine. In this role, you’ll provide both strategic leadership and hands‑on quality oversight for the manufacture and release of designated pathogen‑free animal organs intended for human transplantation—operating at the intersection of FDA, USDA, and global GxP expectations in a truly novel environment. This is a role for a quality leader who thrives on complexity, builds systems that people actually follow, and wants their expertise to directly shape the future of organ transplantation.

The Director, Quality Assurance – Xenotransplantation provides strategic and operational leadership for Quality Assurance systems supporting the manufacture, assessment, and release of designated pathogen‑free (DPF) animal organs intended for human transplantation. This role ensures sustained compliance with FDA, USDA, and global GxP requirements while enabling operational execution across DPF site operations, animal care, laboratories, and manufacturing functions. This position serves as a senior Quality leader for DPF operations, partnering closely with Site Operations, Animal Care, Facilities, Supply Chain, Regulatory Affairs, and R&D to drive inspection readiness, right‑first‑time execution, and continuous improvement in a highly regulated and novel manufacturing environment.

 

* Responsible for strategic planning, direction, and goal setting for the Quality Assurance function of Xenotransplantation
* Provide strategic direction and governance for the DPF Quality Management System (QMS), ensuring compliance with cGMP, cGLP, cGCP (as applicable), FDA, USDA, and internal quality standards
* Establish, maintain, and continuously improve QA policies, procedures, and programs supporting xenotransplantation and organ manufacturing activities
* Own Quality oversight for deviations, investigations, CAPAs, change control, complaints, and product quality reviews
* Ensure robust document control, data integrity, and record retention practices across animal care, laboratories, and manufacturing operations
* Lead Quality Assurance to support regulatory and clinical efforts to reach FDA approval of animal organs for human transplant

new_roles.title: Executive Director, Corporate Quality
new_roles.description:
**About This Role:**

 

The Head of Corporate Quality is responsible for creating and managing the Global Biogen Quality Management System (QMS). The main areas of focus include Quality Systems, internal and external audits for cGMP compliance (including external vendors and CMOs), IT Quality, Technical Product Complaints, and Central Knowledge Management (including documentation).

 
 

This role is central to Quality and PO&T, managing risk, compliance performance, staying compliant with regulatory changes, and seeking opportunities to gain efficiency and effectiveness in the administration of PO&T’s cGMP systems. Additionally, the role is accountable for preparing semi-annual executive-level updates on the state of Biogen’s QMS and informing Executive Management of potential business risks due to a changing regulatory environment or systemic issues within the company. This role also serves as the principal liaison with the R&D Clinical Compliance organization and provides guidance for ICH conformance. Oversight includes biologic products, ASOs, small molecule products, gene therapy, devices, digital, and combination products.

 
 

*This role is hybrid- RTP or hybrid- Cambridge based.*

 

**Travel requirements** : 25% – 50% depending on location. More travel required if not located in RTP.

 
 

**What You’ll Do:**

* Implement integrated quality systems, policies, and standards applicable to all Biogen U.S. and international manufacturing sites and PO&T locations, including Baar, Cambridge, Netherlands, Solothurn, and RTP.
* Develop and maintain a risk assessment process for evaluating and monitoring all cGXP systems.
* Ensure regulatory inspection responses are assessed holistically.
* Establish clear goals and effective metrics that provide insight into industry benchmarks and applicable trends regarding cGMP compliance.
* Oversee external monitoring of regulatory updates (domestic and international) and incorporate changes into Biogen’s QMS as needed.

* Internal and external GxP and ISO audit programs, including risk management and audit program oversight.
* Ensure Biogen’s internal manufacturing sites, Quality Systems, and vendors operate in a state of cGMP compliance, with any risks appropriately communicated and escalated.

**IT QA Department:**

* Oversee GxP IT computerized systems across Biogen, including underlying infrastructure.
* Define appropriate standards and manage lifecycle documentation and supporting processes to ensure compliant implementation and management through retirement.

**Lifecycle Management:**

* Oversee process and compliance-related content (specifically documentation, including governing policies, process documents, and other similar GxP documents) in the electronic document management system.
* Protect, index, classify, and archive GXP records, digitally preserve vital records, manage records lifecycle, and translate GMP content needed in multiple languages.
* Oversee the PO&T training program, providing global guidance and standards to ensure appropriate GxP training is conducted.

**Technical Product Complaint Department:**

* Develop and maintain policies and procedures to manage complaints in line with industry and regulatory standards.
* Identify strategy and provide direction to team members regarding complaint investigation, root cause analysis, CAPAs, regulatory responses, and launch readiness for new products.
* Ensure trending and reporting of complaint cases and metrics, including appropriate escalation and response to significant events.

**Global Management Review (GMR):**

* Act as the chair for the GMR, ensuring ongoing management review and awareness of Biogen Quality and compliance performance (in accordance with cGMP and ICH expectations).
* Prepare semi-annual executive-level updates on the state of Biogen’s QMS based on GMR outcomes.

* Establish short and long-term goals, objectives, and strategies for the Global Corporate Quality organization.
* Ensure appropriate policies and procedures are in place to measure, monitor, and report "actual" versus "planned" results.
* Drive major projects and programs for the Organizational Unit or Function to completion within schedule and budget.
* Manage multiple cost centers and determine the development of overall objectives and long-range goals of the organization.
* Interact directly with senior representatives of regulatory agencies, including the FDA and EMEA.
* Manage direct reports and managers of managers to increase their performance and effectiveness.
 

 

**Who You Are:**

 

You are a seasoned leader in the pharmaceutical industry with an expert understanding of both U.S. and international regulatory requirements. Your influence within an organization is felt through consistent execution and strong leadership competencies. With excellent communication and change management skills, you're adept at leading and implementing change. You thrive in a highly regulated environment and have comprehensive knowledge of the pharmaceutical product development process.

 
 

**Qualifications**

 

**Required Skills:**

* Bachelor’s degree in a related field with a minimum of 15 years of leadership experience in the pharmaceutical industry.
* Minimum of 10 years’ experience leading a Quality Assurance, Regulatory, or Corporate organization at the Director+ level in a highly regulated environment, preferably in biotech, pharmaceutical, or similar industry.
* Experience with the FDA, EMEA, and preferably multiple additional regulatory agencies in other foreign countries.
* Experience in clinical and commercial products as well as both large and small molecule programs, device, and combination products is strongly preferred. ASQ or other auditing certification is beneficial.
* Quality and Compliance experience consistent with worldwide regulatory requirements.
* Expert knowledge of US and International cGxPs, ISO, ICH, and Device regulations.
* Ability to hire and retain top talent with a track record of developing leaders.
* Excellent knowledge of the pharmaceutical product development process, ICH, and device regulations.
* Ability to influence the organization through consistent execution of Biogen leadership competencies.
* Strong leadership abilities required to effectively manage highly capable and high-performing teams.
* Demonstrated ability to lead and implement change, including excellent communication and change management skills.
 

 

**Preferred Skills:**

 

* Advanced degree (PharmD, PhD)
 

 

#LI-NP1

 
 
Job Level: Management 

**Additional Information**

The base compensation range for this role is: $281,000.00-$397,250.00 

Base salary offered is determined through an analytical approach utilizing a combination of factors including, but not limited to, relevant skills & experience, job location, and internal equity.

 

Regular employees are eligible to receive both short term and long-term incentives, including cash bonus and equity incentive opportunities, designed to reward recent achievements and recognize your future potential based on individual, business unit and company performance.

 
 

In addition to compensation, Biogen offers a full and highly competitive range of benefits designed to support our employees’ and their families *physical, financial, emotional,* and *social well-being* ; including, but not limited to:

* Medical, Dental, Vision, & Life insurances
* Fitness & Wellness programs including a fitness reimbursement
* Short- and Long-Term Disability insurance
* A minimum of 15 days of paid vacation and an additional end-of-year shutdown time off (Dec 26-Dec 31)
* Up to 12 company paid holidays + 3 paid days off for Personal Significance
* 80 hours of sick time per calendar year
* Paid Maternity and Parental Leave benefit
* 401(k) program participation with company matched contributions
* Employee stock purchase plan
* Tuition reimbursement of up to $10,000 per calendar year
* Employee Resource Groups participation
 

 

**Why Biogen?**

We are a global team with a commitment to excellence, and a pioneering spirit. As a mid-sized biotechnology company, we provide the stability and resources of a well-established business while fostering an environment where individual contributions make a significant impact. Our team encompasses some of the most talented and passionate achievers who have unparalleled opportunities for learning, growth, and expanding their skills. Above all, we work together to deliver life-changing medicines, with every role playing a vital part in our mission. Caring Deeply. Achieving Excellence. Changing Lives.

 
 

At Biogen, we are committed to building on our culture of inclusion and belonging that reflects the communities where we operate and the patients we serve. We know that diverse backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives make us a stronger and more innovative company, and we are focused on building teams where every employee feels empowered and inspired.

 
 

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital status, race, color, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, religion, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law. Biogen is an E-Verify Employer in the United States.
