new_roles.title: Quality Assurance Bureau Director
new_roles.description:
**Introduction**
----------------

 

It is the mission of the Wisconsin Department of Justice (DOJ) to protect the public and ensure that justice is done. To continue to meet this mission, the principles of equity, inclusion, and employee well-being have become a foundation for all work performed at DOJ, on behalf of Wisconsinites.

The Division of Forensic Sciences, Quality Assurance Bureau is recruiting for a **Forensic Sciences Director** to serve as the Quality Assurance Bureau Director.

The Division of Forensic Sciences (DFS) is comprised of three crime laboratories that are located in Madison, Milwaukee, and Wausau. DFS performs testing and analysis in the following forensic science disciplines: seized drugs, toxicology, trace examination, DNA analysis, DNA databank, firearms and toolmarks, latent print and footwear, forensic imaging, AFIS ten-print examinations, and crime scene response. DFS employs approximately 180 management, forensic scientist and technicians. The laboratories have gone through a rigorous accreditation process and maintains a high level of quality assurance and control.

**Position Summary**
--------------------

 

This position may be headquartered at one of the three crime laboratory locations:

* Milwaukee Crime Laboratory, located at 9400 West Doyne Ave in Wauwatosa, WI.
* Madison Crime Laboratory, located at 4626 University Ave., Madison, WI
* Wausau Crime Laboratory, located at 7100 Stewart Avenue in Wausau, WI.

This position is responsible for the formulation, determination, and implementation of management policy as it relates to the Division of Forensic Sciences’ Quality Assurance Program. This position reports directly to the Administrator of the Division of Forensic Sciences and is a key policy advisor to the Deputy Division Administrator and all Lab Directors within the Division.

Specific responsibilities include but are not limited to: formulation of and implementation of rules, policies and procedures; management of the Wisconsin State Crime Laboratories’ accreditation process and preparation; and implementation of industry required division audits and training. This position addresses complex division quality issues such as non-conformances and proficiency testing and has fiscal responsibilities related to training, accreditation, proficiency testing and instrumentation.

For more information, please review the position description.

**Salary Information**
----------------------

 

The Forensic Science Director classification is in pay schedule 81 and range 01. The starting salary for this position will be between $58.00 - $61.08/hr. ($120,640 - $127,046 annually), depending upon experience and qualifications. Pay for former and current state employees will be in accordance with the State of Wisconsin Compensation Plan. A 2-year career executive trial period is required. probation may be required.

The State of Wisconsin offers amazing benefits, such as:

* Generous paid time off, including at least 3 1/2 weeks of vacation/personal time, and nine paid holidays.
 + Sick time that rolls over each year with no cap and may be used to pay for healthcare premiums in retirement.
 - Affordable health insurance, dental, vision, life, and more.
 * A top-notch retirement program and optional tax advantaged 457 retirement savings plan.
 * A Well Wisconsin program, offering wellness tools and rewards to employees and spouses.

To learn more about DOJ’s total compensation package, please visit our Total Rewards Calculator!

**Job Details**
---------------

 

The Department of Justice does not sponsor work visas at the time of hire or anytime during employment. All persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and complete the required Employment Eligibility Form I-9.

An extensive background check, including fingerprints, will be completed on applicants prior to selection.

**Qualifications**
------------------

 

**Please clearly and thoroughly address the following in your resume and/or letter of qualifications.**

**Minimally qualified applicants must have training, education or experience in all of the following:**

* Experience working with and adhering to ISO/IEC 17025 and ANAB or A2LA accreditation requirements for forensic laboratories.
* Experience supervising and managing staff, such as planning and coordination workflow, evaluating performance, making hiring recommendations.
* Developing, implementing, monitoring, and/or improving laboratory quality assurance programs, policies, and procedures.
* Experience (to include previous) working cases in a forensic discipline (e.g., DNA, toxicology, firearms, etc.) thus providing insight into the operational challenges and day-to-day demands of laboratory work.

**Well-qualified applicants will have met all of the minimally qualified criterion** **and** **a combination of the following:**

* Managing a forensic science laboratory or unit, such as supervising, managing, and developing staff, developing operating budgets, resource allocation, and reviewing fiscal statements.
* Conducting, managing, or responding to accreditation assessments or external audits.
* Leading organizational change and collaborating across multiple laboratories or work units.

In addition to the above listed qualifications and to provide oversight support to DNA Quality-wide programs that follow FBI Quality standards for DNA personnel, it is preferred that the incumbent have the following:

* Bachelor’s degree in biology, chemistry or forensic science-related area and shall have successfully completed 12 semester or equivalent credit hours from the following subject areas: biochemistry, genetics, molecular biology, and statistics or population genetics.

**How To Apply**
----------------

 

The steps to apply online are quick and easy! Your application materials, including your resume and letter of qualifications, are used during our evaluation process to determine your eligibility for further consideration. It is critically important that your application materials clearly describe your experience related to the stated job qualifications. Please review our helpful tips for developing your resume and letter of qualifications and what should be included. Be advised that there will be no opportunity to change your application materials once you have clicked “Submit.”

Permanent classified state employees who are eligible for consideration (transfer or voluntary demotion) should complete the application process as described above by the stated deadline.

The WI Department of Justice is committed to providing opportunities to all applicants from all backgrounds. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

The State of Wisconsin offers a special program for qualified veterans with a 30% or greater service-connected disability. If you are a qualified veteran, please visit the Veterans Employment page for application instructions to be considered for the Veterans Non-Competitive Appointment program.

Submitted materials will be evaluated by a panel of job experts and the most qualified applicants will be invited to participate in the next step of the selection process. We appreciate the time and effort it takes to apply for positions. If any questions arise, please contact the DOJ Recruiter email at dojrecruiter@wisdoj.gov.

For general wisc.jobs user information and technical assistance, please see the wisc.jobs Frequently Asked Questions page.

**Deadline to Apply**
---------------------

 

The deadline to apply for this job announcement is **November 30****th****, 2026, at 11:59 PM.**

new_roles.title: Vice President of Home Operations (Upper-Midwest Based)
new_roles.description:
**Vice President of Home Operations**

The Vice President of Home Operations leads the production side of Liechty Homes: every step from factory order and delivery through set, finish and charge-out (final closeout and handoff to accounting), then service and warranty. The role is built around one measure: how many homes Liechty can deliver each year, on time and at quality.

Liechty International operates manufactured housing dealerships and communities across North Dakota, South Dakota and Minnesota and is expanding. Home Operations is becoming system-driven: one production schedule, clear handoffs from Sales, and dependable crews and subcontractors.

We believe that a great VP of Home Operations will be an architect who designs a system that moves every home on schedule; a general who sets the direction and keeps every team moving in step; a team builder who recruits, develops and keeps great crews and leaders; and a steward who grows capacity while protecting quality, margin and the customer.

Key Responsibilities & Deliverables

* Own annual delivery capacity (homes per year, on time and at quality) and lead the plan to grow it, region by region, in balance with sales.

* Own the production system and its standards, with dashboards that flag at-risk homes right away.

* Shape the set crew and subcontractor strategy: how much set work stays in-house, where crews are based, and the safety standards for transport and crew work.

* Recruit, develop and retain the Home Operations team, including the people who line up crews, trucks, equipment and materials ahead of each home's schedule.

* Be accountable for order timing, build quality and delivery logistics with manufacturing partners.

* Establish a formal Sales-to-Operations handoff so every home enters production ready to build.

* Lead service and warranty, and set their standards, through the Warranty Manager.

* Own the Home Operations P&L and bring the CEO business cases for capacity investments.

Required Qualifications

* 8+ years of operations leadership in homebuilding, manufactured or modular housing, construction or another production environment, including leading other leaders.

* Construction or project management expertise, including building and running schedules and systems that coordinate many concurrent jobs, crews and subcontractors.

* P&L ownership, command of unit economics, cost control and capital planning, and strong negotiation skills with manufacturers, subcontractors and vendors.

* Experience deploying workflow, scheduling or ERP software and running operations from data; comfort adopting AI-enabled tools and training others on them.

* A record of building strong field teams and leading them through change by bringing people along, with high Emotional Intelligence (EQ).

* Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Business or a related field, or equivalent experience; an MBA is a plus.

Preferred

* Manufactured or modular housing experience: factory coordination, home set and HUD code.

* Experience scaling operations through new locations or acquisitions.

* Continuous improvement experience in cutting cycle time and rework.

Reporting & Success Measures

Reports to the Chief Executive Officer and serves on the executive team. Directly supervises the Production Manager and the Warranty Manager. Works daily with the VP of Sales and branch managers, Finance, and manufacturing partners. This role can be performed remotely and requires travel monthly or more often.

Success in this role is measured by:

* Homes delivered per year, on time and at quality, growing in balance with sales.

new_roles.title: Vice President of Operations
new_roles.description:
At Emmi Roth, we’re passionate about creating exceptional cheeses. As a leader in the specialty cheese industry, we blend traditional craftsmanship with innovation. Our commitment to local sourcing and quality makes us a trusted brand in the food industry.

Joining Emmi Roth means becoming part of a team that values creativity, collaboration, and a shared dedication to excellence. You’ll have the opportunity to work with some of the finest cheeses in the world while contributing to a company that prides itself on both heritage and progress. If you're passionate about food, craftsmanship, and making an impact, we’d love for you to be a part of our journey!

**Summary** 
The Vice President of Operations serves as a core member of Emmi Roth’s Executive Leadership Team, shaping and advancing the enterprise’s operational agenda across all manufacturing sites. This role defines the long-term Operations vision, aligns enterprise strategy with operational priorities, and ensures sustained, world-class performance across safety, quality, service, cost, and sustainability.

Operating with full executive authority within established governance frameworks, the Vice President of Operations partners closely with the VP of Supply Chain to jointly steward end-to-end value chain outcomes, balancing performance, resilience, and growth.

**Duties and Responsibilities** 
**Executive Accountability & Scope** 

* Enterprise-wide accountability for operational outcomes across all manufacturing facilities, including safety, quality, service, productivity, cost, and ESG outcomes
* Strategic leadership of the Operations function, establishing strategic direction, enterprise priorities, and performance frameworks that enable long-term success
* Oversight of manufacturing, production, employee safety, food safety, maintenance, engineering, R& D and operational excellence capabilities, with full decision authority across these domains
* Ownership of the Operations P&L, including financial performance, capital allocation, and long-range investment strategy, with authority to direct resources within approved plans
* Definition and advancement of a multi-year Operations strategy aligned with Emmi Roth and Emmi Group objectives
* Enterprise accountability for compliance, risk management, and governance across food safety, quality, regulatory, environmental, and employee safety standards
* Strategic partnership with the VP of Supply Chain to co-own value chain performance, aligning trade-offs and outcomes across service, cost, inventory, and supply continuity
* Leadership of organizational capability, including leadership and development, succession planning, and leadership pipeline development within Operations

**Executive Leadership and Responsibilities** 

* Active contributor to enterprise strategy and decision-making as a member of the Executive Leadership Team
* Drives and owns organizational design and functional maturity, ensuring the Operations organization evolves in line with business growth and complexity
* Strategic liaison with Emmi Group Supply Chain leadership, ensuring alignment, transparency, and global integration
* Executive sponsor of capital strategy, manufacturing network evolution, automation, and digital transformation initiatives, with authority aligned to enterprise investment governance
* Executive representative of Operations with internal and external stakeholders, reinforcing credibility, influence, and enterprise alignment

**Strategic & Operational Leadership** 

* Translate enterprise strategy into integrated operational priorities, roadmaps, and measurable business outcomes
* Leverage data, insights, and forward-looking indicators to anticipate risk, identify opportunity, and guide enterprise-level decisions
* Champion enterprise initiatives, including continuous improvement, advanced manufacturing, automation, and productivity acceleration
* Establish and uphold enterprise-wide performance systems, ensuring transparency, rigor, and accountability at all levels
* Foster a culture grounded in safety, quality, ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement
* Provide leadership in navigating complex, cross-functional challenges, ensuring alignment and decisive, enterprise-level resolution

 
**Qualifications** 
Required qualifications, skills, and experience for the job; education background, certifications, relevant work experience, technical skills, and soft skills. 

* Degree in Business, Engineering, Supply Chain, or related discipline
* MBA or equivalent advanced degree preferred, or comparable experience
* Extensive senior leadership experience within Operations, preferably in complex manufacturing environments
* Demonstrated success within food manufacturing
* Proven accountability for operational P&L performance and capital investment strategy
* Track record of leading enterprise transformation and large-scale operational initiatives
* Fluency in English required; additional languages advantageous

**Competency Profile** 

* Enterprise-oriented leader with the ability to balance strategic vision and operational depth
* Decisive, outcomes-focused leader with demonstrated ownership and accountability for outcomes in complex environments
* Collaborative value chain leader, adept at aligning cross-functional priorities and delivering integrated results
* Exceptional developer of talent, with a focus on leadership capability, succession, and organizational effectiveness
* High degree of leadership presence, emotional intelligence, and resilience, with the ability to influence at all levels

**Benefits** 

* Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance
* Basic Life Insurance
* Voluntary Life Insurance
* Flexible spending accounts & Health Savings Accounts
* 401k Retirement Plan
* Paid Holidays
* Paid Vacation
* Employee Assistance Program
* Short term/Long term disability
* Volunteer time off (VTO)
* Tuition Reimbursement
* Pet insurance

**The Best Cheese Moments are EMMI ROTH Moments!**

*Equal Opportunity Employer Minorities/Women/Veterans/Disabled*

new_roles.description:
Description:

### **JOB SUMMARY:**

The General Manager reports directly to the President and leads the Watertown, Connecticut location. This role translates company strategy into daily execution and is accountable for site performance in safety, quality, delivery, cost, employee engagement, and customer satisfaction.

As a member of the Leadership Team, the General Manager establishes operational controls, reporting systems, and performance expectations to improve profitability, workforce development, manufacturing efficiency, and long-term business sustainability. The role collaborates with Sales, Finance, Engineering, Human Resources, Quality, and Operations across locations.

### **ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:**

#### **Operational Leadership & Strategy:**

* Lead daily site operations and align departmental priorities, resources, and execution with company strategy.
* Promote a culture of safety, accountability, teamwork, and continuous improvement.
* Establish and monitor performance indicators for safety, quality, on-time delivery, labor efficiency, inventory accuracy, first-pass yield, productivity, and profitability.
* Use operational reports and dashboards to identify performance gaps, assign corrective actions, and monitor results.

#### **Process & Financial Performance:**

* Manage site operational budgeting, labor planning, cost controls, and financial performance in collaboration with Finance and within approved authority.
* Lead initiatives to reduce waste, improve workflow, standardize processes, and apply lean manufacturing principles.
* Coordinate production priorities and resource planning across departments and locations to support customer commitments.
* Evaluate and implement approved technology, automation, and AI-enabled tools where appropriate to improve efficiency and reduce non-value-added work.

#### **Safety, Quality & Customer Collaboration:**

* Manage and continuously improve the site safety program in coordination with designated company resources; ensure adherence to applicable company policies and safety and environmental requirements.
* Ensure site adherence to applicable quality management systems and ISO requirements; support audits, root cause analysis, corrective actions, and continuous improvement.
* Partner with Sales, Engineering, Quality, and customer-facing teams to address customer needs, delivery commitments, product quality, and issue resolution.

#### **Leadership & Talent Development:**

* Lead and mentor department managers and operational leaders to improve accountability, consistency, and professional development.
* Develop succession plans and leadership development initiatives to strengthen organizational depth and business continuity.
* Partner with Human Resources on workforce planning, employee

Requirements:

### **SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Provide site-level leadership and oversight of department managers and operational leaders within the assigned reporting structure.
* Establish performance expectations, provide regular feedback, and assess development needs in coordination with Human Resources and company leadership.

### **QUALIFICATIONS:**

#### **Required Skills & Competencies:**

* Strong business acumen and understanding of manufacturing operations, finance, quality systems, supply chain, customer service, sales support, and workforce management.
* Ability to lead operational change, build trust, and develop accountability and employee engagement across organizational levels.
* Proficiency in manufacturing metrics, operational reporting, financial analysis, and cost controls.
* Experience implementing process improvements, lean manufacturing initiatives, and operational standardization.
* Ability to use ERP/MRP systems, reporting tools, and other business systems to improve operational effectiveness.

#### **Education & Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Operations Management, or a related field preferred, but not required.
* At least eight years of progressive leadership experience in manufacturing, printing, converting, industrial production, or a related operational environment.
* Demonstrated success leading teams in a fast-paced manufacturing environment with responsibility for operational performance and measurable business results.
* Experience with custom manufacturing, technical products, labels, graphic overlays, membrane switches, or related industries preferred.
* Experience managing within ISO-certified or regulated manufacturing environments preferred.

### **LANGUAGE SKILLS:**

* Strong interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present information internally and externally across organizational levels.
* Bilingual English/Spanish communication skills strongly preferred to support employee engagement, training, and operational communication.

### **MATHEMATICAL & ANALYTICAL SKILLS:**

* Ability to interpret budgets, labor and production data, costs, inventory reports, and operational performance trends.
* Ability to use data to evaluate priorities, identify causes of performance gaps, and assess improvement results.

### **REASONING ABILITY:**

* Ability to think and act strategically and tactically, manage competing priorities, and make sound operational decisions.
* Ability to analyze problems, evaluate alternatives, and coordinate practical solutions across departments.

### **WORK ENVIRONMENT:**

* Work is performed in office and manufacturing settings, with exposure to moving production equipment when entering production areas.
* Follow applicable site safety procedures and use required personal protective equipment in designated areas.
* Travel to customers, vendors, and JN White corporate as needed.

**Position Type and Compensation** 
This is a full-time, salaried, exempt position based in Watertown, Connecticut. The annual base salary range is $120,000–$150,000. Compensation within this range will be determined based on relevant experience, qualifications, skills, and internal equity.

**Benefits** 
JN White offers medical, dental, and vision insurance, with premium costs shared between the employee and employer. A variety of ancillary insurance benefits are also available; employee contributions and employer contributions, where applicable, vary by coverage elected.

Additional benefits include paid time off (PTO), paid holidays, a 401(k) retirement plan, and profit sharing. Benefits are subject to applicable eligibility requirements, waiting periods, company policies, and governing plan documents. Profit sharing is subject to plan terms and is not guaranteed.

**Equal Employment Opportunity** 
JN White is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religious creed, age, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, ancestry, disability, genetic information, veteran or military status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

**Reasonable Accommodations** 
JN White provides reasonable accommodations to qualified applicants and employees as required by applicable law. Applicants who need an accommodation to participate in the application or interview process may contact Human Resources.

**Employment Disclaimer** 
This posting describes the general nature of the position and does not constitute an offer of employment or an employment contract. Employment with JN White is at will, subject to applicable law. Duties and responsibilities may change based on business needs.

new_roles.description:
**Job Title: Plant Manager**

**Job Type: On-Site**

**Location: Orange, CA**

**Reporting to: VP of Manufacturing**

**Company Overview**

FXI is a leading producer of foam innovation in the Bedding, Furniture, Industrial, Home & Office, Healthcare, and Transportation markets. We have made it our mission to provide tailored solutions that delight our customers and consumers. With our corporate headquarters, high-tech research and development facility, and multiple manufacturing locations in North America, FXI has built a culture of innovation and achievement that is recognized by customers, suppliers and peers. Our products include finished goods, sub-assemblies, services, and raw materials for OEMs, fabricators, and retailers. You will find FXI's foam innovations inside, around, and under yourself in countless applications. Everywhere foam goes, FXI's innovations lead the way! Won't you join us?

**Job Overview:**

Reporting to the Manufacturing Vice President, the Plant Manager plans, directs, and coordinates the operations of the plant. The Plant Manager has leadership responsibility to assure compliance with all government and company policies and procedures. This position will also be responsible for facility production goals and objectives. Following FXI's Vision, Mission and Values, the Plant Manager is to develop a well-trained and motivated staff with emphasis on plant safety and employee engagement.

**Responsibilities:**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering (Industrial, Mechanical, Manufacturing, Chemical, or related discipline) preferred.

* Direct and coordinate plant operations in strict compliance with all state and federal laws, regulations, corporate policies and procedures
* Responsible for achieving all facility business goals including, but not limited to, the areas of safety, quality, production, reliability and P&L.

* Maintain a clean and safe plant; incorporate a 5S culture for conducting all work activities.

* Develop and foster a high‑performing, well‑trained, and motivated workforce by assessing current skill sets and aligning talent development with the plant's future growth, vision, and manufacturing excellence across all functions.

* Lead the development, implementation, and governance of plant performance metrics and KPIs to monitor progress toward site objectives and drive continuous improvement.

* Conduct and assure all required employee development and performance reviews are completed to promote individual continuous improvement per the required corporate schedule.

* Attend scheduled corporate training and meetings. Need to be a key leader moving the company forward to meet strategic and business plan objectives.
* Ensures that all plant assets are properly managed, safeguarded, and secure.

* Develop, submit for approval, and implement approved Capital Projects as required to meet facility strategic plans and business needs.

* Develop and ensure management systems are in place to monitor plant output, cuts / yields and scrap to ensure efficient resource utilization and initiate corrective action as required.

* Establish and maintain a positive community relationship.

**Qualifications:**

* 10 years of prior experience in a manufacturing environment
* Prior experience as Production / Operations Manager.
* Strong interpersonal, problem solving and leadership skills with the ability to lead a team motivate the group and manage a diverse workforce.
* Excellent, engaging communicator; able to set measurable goals and expectations and hold team members accountable for results

* Demonstrated experience and working knowledge of Lean Manufacturing principles and structured problem‑solving tools (e.g., 5S, Kaizen, Value Stream Mapping, Root Cause Analysis, A3, 5 Whys) to drive continuous improvement and operational excellence.

* Action-oriented and eager to drive programs through to completion. Able to deal with pressures and timelines inherent in a fast-paced company
* Ability to quickly assess the situation at the plant and have an impact on the direction of improvements
* Ability to function as a strong leader, bringing the Operations perspective while promoting cross-functional horizontal alignment to achieve key company goals
* Hands-on leader who contributes to overall business strategy and issues, works well as part of the leadership team, and is focused upon achieving results
* Team player and coach who will promote cooperation among employees in the organization and an environment of employee engagement
* Possess the confidence and presence to be able to deal effectively with external customers, vendors, and all levels within the organization
* Strong, self-confident, decisive leader with excellent listening skills, emotional maturity, and ability to adapt to a rapidly changing environment

**Our Commitment to a Diverse Workforce:** FXI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. FXI does not discriminate in employment matters on the basis of race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, military service eligibility, veteran status, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, or based on any individual's membership in any group or class protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. We support workplace diversity. We strongly believe that diversity contributes to a broader collective perspective that will consistently lead to a better company and better products. We are working hard to increase the diversity of our team wherever we can.

***We are interested in every*** ***qualified candidate who is eligible to work in the United States. However, we are not able to sponsor visas.***

FXI is not accepting unsolicited assistance from search firms for this employment opportunity. Please, no phone calls or emails. All resumes submitted by search firms to any employee at FXI via-email, the Internet or in any form and/or method without a valid written search agreement in place for this position will be deemed the sole property of FXI. No fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by FXI as a result of the referral or through other means.

**Here, you will make a difference every day. You will be supported to build a rewarding career with opportunities to grow, innovate and inspire. Make history with us.**

**Why Campbell’s…**

* Benefits begin on day one and include medical, dental, short and long-term disability, AD&D, and life insurance (for individual, families, and domestic partners).
* Employees are eligible for our matching 401(k) plan and can enroll on the first day of employment with immediate vesting.
* Campbell’s offers unlimited sick time along with paid time off and holiday pay.
* If in WHQ – free access to the fitness center. Access to on-site day care (operated by Bright Horizons) and company store.
* Giving back to the communities where our employees work and live is very important to Campbell’s. Our “Campbell’s Cares” program matches employee donations and/or volunteer activity up to $1,500 annually.
* Campbell’s has a variety of Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) to support employees.

**Job Description**

The Vice President, Manufacturing – Fresh Bakery provides strategic and operational leadership for Campbell’s Fresh Bakery manufacturing network, including bakery operations in Bloomfield, Connecticut; Downers Grove, Illinois; Lakeland, Florida; and Denver, Pennsylvania. This leader establishes the manufacturing strategy, operating priorities, performance expectations, and transformation agenda for the network, ensuring consistent execution across safety, quality, service, cost, reliability, productivity, and people.

Leading through the Plant Managers, the VP creates alignment across sites while maintaining clear site-level accountability for day-to-day operations and results. The role builds manufacturing capability and organizational talent across the network, identifies and addresses systemic performance opportunities, and drives continuous improvement and transformation to strengthen the long-term competitiveness of the Fresh Bakery business.

This leader partners across Supply Chain and the broader organization to align manufacturing strategy, capabilities, capacity, capital priorities, and resources with business needs. The incumbent must be an enterprise-minded business partner who creates direction, enables effective decisions, builds talent and culture, drives disciplined execution, and owns results across the network.

**Essential Job Duties**

**Manufacturing Strategy & Network Leadership:** Define and lead the multi-year manufacturing strategy for the Fresh Bakery network. Translate business and Supply Chain priorities into clear site objectives, integrated roadmaps, operating plans, and performance expectations. Maintain clarity between network-level strategic direction and Plant Manager ownership of daily site operations.

**Safety, Quality & Operating Integrity:** Set expectations and governance for employee safety, food safety, product quality, environmental responsibility, and regulatory compliance across all bakery sites. Ensure effective management systems, standards, controls, and escalation routines are in place, while holding Plant Managers accountable for site execution and results.

**Network Performance Management & Accountability:** Establish the operating cadence and performance-management system for safety, quality, service, cost, labor, yield, waste, reliability, customer service, and employee engagement. Review performance across sites, identify systemic gaps and best practices, define corrective actions, and ensure clear ownership and follow-through.

**Manufacturing Transformation & Operational Excellence:** Lead the transformation agenda for Fresh Bakery manufacturing, creating consistent operating systems, standards, and management routines across the network. Build a culture of continuous improvement and zero loss, and use Lean Manufacturing, Total Productive Maintenance, equipment reliability, and problem-solving disciplines to deliver sustainable improvements.

**Cost, Productivity & Business Performance:** Deliver network productivity, cost, waste, and efficiency commitments through disciplined planning and execution. Connect operational performance to financial outcomes, evaluate trade-offs, and mobilize cross-site resources to address significant performance gaps or opportunities.

**Capacity, Capability & Capital Strategy:** Shape network capacity, capability, technology, and capital priorities based on demand, growth, service, risk, and long-term business needs. Sponsor major capital and capability initiatives, ensure disciplined prioritization and governance, and partner with Engineering and other functions to achieve intended business outcomes.

**Talent, Leadership & Culture%:** Build a strong and diverse manufacturing leadership pipeline across the Fresh Bakery network. Coach and develop Plant Managers and senior site leaders; strengthen succession, bench strength, workforce planning, engagement, and retention; and create a high-performing culture grounded in accountability, collaboration, inclusion, and continuous improvement.

**Cross-Functional & Enterprise Partnership:** Partner with Planning, Procurement, Engineering, Quality, Logistics, Research & Development, Commercial, Finance, People & Culture, and other stakeholders to align priorities, solve network constraints, support innovation and commercialization, manage risk, and deliver enterprise outcomes. Serve as the senior manufacturing voice for the Fresh Bakery business.

**Required Education & Skills**

· Bachelor's degree strongly preferred or an Associate's degree with significant experience.

· Fresh Bakery manufacturing experience strongly preferred

· 15+ years of progressive manufacturing/operations experience

· Prior experience as a Plant Manager, General Manager, Director of Site Operations, or comparable senior manufacturing leader

· Significant people leadership experience, including leadership of senior operational leaders

· Demonstrated manufacturing leadership experience

· Multi-site leadership experience, likely something I'd make required or strongly preferred

**Preferred Experienc** e

· Multi-site manufacturing leadership experience, including leadership through Plant Managers or comparable senior site leaders.

· Experience in food manufacturing or consumer packaged goods (CPG) within a complex, high-volume manufacturing network.

· Demonstrated experience leading large-scale manufacturing transformation and operational excellence, with a track record of driving sustainable improvements in safety, quality, service, cost, reliability, and productivity.

· Experience applying Lean Manufacturing, Total Productive Maintenance (TPM), reliability, Six Sigma, or other continuous improvement methodologies at scale.

· Experience developing manufacturing network strategy, including capacity, asset utilization, capital investment, and long-term capability planning.

· Demonstrated experience developing senior manufacturing leaders and building succession and bench strength across multiple operations.

· Experience managing significant operating budgets, productivity commitments, capital investments, and/or P&L responsibility.

· Strong business acumen and demonstrated ability to work across Planning, Engineering, Quality, Logistics, Procurement, Finance, Commercial, R&D, and People & Culture to deliver business outcomes.

· Advanced degree in Business, Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, or a related field preferred.

**Physical Requirements**

This role requires regular work in manufacturing environments and a visible presence across bakery facilities, including walking, standing, climbing stairs, and accessing production, warehouse, and office areas. The incumbent must be able to wear required personal protective equipment and work a flexible schedule as business needs require.

**Travel**

This role requires **at least 75% travel** , primarily to Campbell’s Fresh Bakery manufacturing sites and Headquarters. Regular and sustained on-site presence is expected to provide visible leadership, build strong partnerships with Plant Managers and site leadership teams, understand operating conditions firsthand, and support execution of manufacturing priorities and transformation initiatives

 

**Compensation and Benefits:**

The target base salary range for this full-time, salaried position is between

$221,500-$304,600

Individual base pay depends on work location and additional factors such as experience, job-related skills, and relevant education or training. Total pay may include other forms of compensation. In addition, we offer competitive health, dental, 401k and wellness benefits beginning on the first day of employment. Please ask your Talent Acquisition Partner for more information about our total rewards package.

**The Company is committed to providing equal opportunity for employees and qualified applicants in all aspects of the employment relationship, including consideration for employment, without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, citizenship, marital status, protected veteran status, disability, age, religion, or any other classification protected by law.**

**Work Location** :

New York, New York, United States of America

**Hours:**

40

**Line of Business:**

TD Securities

**Pay Detail:**

$225,000 - $225,000 USD

TD is committed to providing fair and equitable compensation opportunities to all colleagues. Growth opportunities and skill development are defining features of the colleague experience at TD. Our compensation policies and practices have been designed to allow colleagues to progress through the salary range over time as they progress in their role. The base pay actually offered may vary based upon the candidate's skills and experience, job-related knowledge, geographic location, and other specific business and organizational needs.

As a candidate, you are encouraged to ask compensation related questions and have an open dialogue with your recruiter who can provide you more specific details for this role.

**Job Description:**

Conducts a range of comprehensive analysis and research on individual corporations, industries, financial markets and/or economic developments to support business needs and publish high quality research reports/presentations aligned to industries and various markets. Also provides critical insights and industry information to support advisory services.

 

**Depth & Scope:**

* Highly seasoned professional role requiring substantial knowledge / expertise in a complex field and knowledge of broader related areas
* Takes a lead role in modeling and interpretation of advanced insights within research reports
* Integrates knowledge of sub-function's overarching strategy in developing solutions across multiple functions or operations
* Interprets internal/external business challenges and the industry environment, recommends course of action and best practices to improve products, processes, or services
* Solves or may lead others to solve complex problems; leads efforts or partners with others to develop new solutions
* Uses sophisticated analytical thought to exercise judgement and identify solutions
* Communicates difficult concepts; converts information to compelling business context and advice; influences and gains alignment across increasingly senior stakeholders
* Acts as a technical expert / lead integrating cross-functional knowledge, impacting the achievement of business objectives
* Work is guided by policies and industry standards/methods
Works autonomously as the lead and guide others within area of expertise 

 

**Education & Experience:**

* Undergraduate degree
* Masters or PhD preferred
* CFA designation preferred for publishing analysts and associates
5+ years related experience 

 

**Customer Accountabilities:**

* Works closely with the sales and trading group to develop new relationships, and with other analysts and associates to provide ongoing guidance
* Develops and maintains contacts and relationships in the community and with institutional clients
* Leads in the compilation and evaluation of multiple data inputs for:
 + Companies/industries and/or
 + Financial markets and economic analysis research reports (e.g., initiating coverage reports, thematic reports, quarterly reporting initiatives, and marketing packages)
* Publishes high quality, comprehensive analysis and research on industry sectors and companies and/or financial markets and economic development
* Develops business relationships and generates profits from producing and sharing regular research publications
Provides service to clients (internal and external) in the form of information, expertise, analysis, and opinions regarding market information, financial markets, economic outlook, and investment strategies 

 

**Shareholder Accountabilities:**

* Keeps abreast of market data, economic information, and key industry developments, as well as internal policies and regulatory standards (as communicated by Compliance) at all times to assist in maximizing profitability through sound and well-informed decisions; develop and maintain contacts with market participants
* Demonstrates governance, control, and risk management behaviors in alignment with TD policies and practices
* Adheres to enterprise frameworks or methodologies that relate to activities for our business area
* Ensures respective programs/policies/practices are well managed, meets business needs, complies with internal and external requirements, and aligns with business priorities
* Consistently exercises discretion in managing correspondence, information, and all matters of confidentiality; escalate issues where appropriate
* Participates in cross-functional/enterprise initiatives as a subject matter expert helping to identify risk/provide guidance for complex situations
* Conducts internal and external research projects; support the development/delivery of presentations and communications to management or broader audience
* Conducts meaningful analysis at the functional or enterprise level using results to draw conclusions, make recommendations, assess the effectiveness of programs/policies/practices
* Monitors service, productivity, and assess efficiency levels within own function and implement continuous process/performance improvements where opportunities exist
* Actively manages relationships within and across various business lines, corporate, and/or control functions and ensures alignment with enterprise and/or regulatory requirements
Maintains a culture of risk management and control, supported by effective processes in alignment with risk appetite 

 

**Employee/Team Accountabilities:**

* Participates fully as a member of the team, support a positive work environment that promotes service to the business, quality, innovation, and teamwork, and ensure timely communication of issues/points of interest
* Provides thought leadership and/or industry knowledge for own area of expertise and participate in knowledge transfer within the team and business unit
* Keeps current on emerging trends/developments and grow knowledge of the business, related tools, and techniques
* Participates in personal performance management and development activities, including cross training within own team
* Keeps others informed and up to date about the status/progress of projects and/or all relevant or useful information related to day-to-day activities
* Contributes to team development of skills and capabilities through mentorship of others, by sharing knowledge and experiences and leveraging best practices
* Leads, motivates, and develops relationships with internal and external business partners/stakeholders to develop productive working relationships
* Contributes to a fair, positive, and equitable environment that supports a diverse workforce
Acts as a brand ambassador for your business area/function and the bank, both internally and/or externally 

 

**Physical Requirements:**

Never: 0%; Occasional: 1-33%; Frequent: 34-66%; Continuous: 67-100%

* Domestic Travel – Occasional
* International Travel – Never
* Performing sedentary work – Continuous
* Performing multiple tasks – Continuous
* Operating standard office equipment - Continuous
* Responding quickly to sounds – Occasional
* Sitting – Continuous

* Lifting/Carrying (under 25 lbs.) – Occasional

* Concentrating for long periods of time – Continuous
* Applying common sense to deal with problems involving standardized situations – Continuous
* Reading, writing, and comprehending instructions – Continuous
Adding, subtracting, multiplying, and dividing – Continuous

They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required. The listed or specified responsibilities & duties are considered essential functions for ADA purposes.

**Who We Are**

TD Securities offers a wide range of capital markets products and services to corporate, government, and institutional clients who choose us for our innovation, execution, and experience. With more than 6,500 professionals operating out of 40 cities across the globe, we strive to make every interaction, product and experience remarkably human and refreshingly simple. Our services include underwriting and distributing new issues, providing trusted advice and industry-leading insight, extending access to global markets, and delivering integrated transaction banking solutions. In 2023, we acquired Cowen Inc., offering our clients access to a premier U.S. equities business and highly-diverse equity research franchise, while growing our strong, diversified investment bank.

Together, we are reimagining what banking can be for our clients, colleagues and communities.

**Our Total Rewards Package** 
Our Total Rewards package reflects the investments we make in our colleagues to help them and their families achieve their financial, physical and mental well-being goals. Total Rewards at TD includes base salary and variable compensation/incentive awards (e.g., eligibility for cash and/or equity incentive awards, generally through participation in an incentive plan) and several other key plans such as health and well-being benefits, savings and retirement programs, paid time off (including Vacation PTO, Flex PTO, and Holiday PTO), banking benefits and discounts, career development, and reward and recognition. Learn more

**Additional Information:** 
We’re delighted that you’re considering building a career with TD. Through regular development conversations, training programs, and a competitive benefits plan, we’re committed to providing the support our colleagues need to thrive both at work and at home.
 
 
**Colleague Development**

If you’re interested in a specific career path or are looking to build certain skills, we want to help you succeed. You’ll have regular career, development, and performance conversations with your manager, as well as access to an online learning platform and a variety of mentoring programs to help you unlock future opportunities.

If you’re passionate about helping clients and building deep, lasting relationships, TD offers diverse career paths where you can grow your expertise and make a meaningful impact.

We're committed to your success and foster a respectful workplace where diverse perspectives are valued, everyone has fair opportunities to grow, and you can unlock your full potential to achieve your career goals. Here at TD, we hire and develop the best.

**Training & Onboarding** 
We will provide training and onboarding sessions to ensure that you’ve got everything you need to succeed in your new role.
 
 
**Interview Process** 
We’ll reach out to candidates of interest to schedule an interview. We do our best to communicate outcomes to all applicants by email or phone call.

**Accommodation**

TD Bank is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, status as a protected veteran or any other characteristic protected under applicable federal, state, or local law.

If you are an applicant with a disability and need accommodations to complete the application process, please email TD Bank US Workplace Accommodations Program at USWAPTDO@td.com . Include your full name, best way to reach you and the accommodation needed to assist you with the applicant process.

new_roles.description:
**Job Summary**

The Quality/CI Director is responsible for overseeing the overall quality management system and lean management systems; including the continuous development, improvement & maturity, and supporting the forward vision & business objectives of the segment. This position will support with a dotted line, 40+ plant locations and will work under the general direction of the Regional VP positions.

 

**Location**

Any UFP packaging plant in TX, AZ, OK, OR, UT preferred.

 

**Principle Duties and Responsibilities**

* Oversees the overall quality management systems of the business segments and their impact on our business & customers.
* Oversees the overall continuous improvement program for the business segment through standardized practices, training, meeting improvement objectives, and continuing to mature our systems and capabilities.
* Assist the plant locations in maintaining compliance with the quality management system to ISO9001 requirements and sustaining our certification status.
* Assist quality & CI training to plant quality managers/coordinators as turnover occurs.
* Drive standardization into our quality management & lean management systems insuring best & consistent practices.
* Assist new methodologies & technologies which impact quality & improvements (such as software & SCADA systems).
* Support onboarding of new and strategic customers within PPAP processes.
* Provide training & training material for the CI program & initiatives. Serve as coach & mentor for improvement projects.
* Host regional CI progress meetings with each region to help support progress & best practices.
* Take initiative on developing next steps & objectives to evolve & mature the effectiveness of our systems and provide necessary training.
Provide high level analysis from data/metrics of how effective our systems are and make recommendations and/or take action for improvement. 

 

**Qualifications**

* CQE ( *certified quality engineer* ) Certification Preferred or equivalent discipline body of knowledge.
* Minimum of five years of experience in Quality manufacturing environment is required.
* Working knowledge of ISO9001 QMS systems, and preferred understanding of IATF 16949 (formally TS) & AIAG practices.
* Working knowledge of Quality Science applications.
* High-level understanding of lean concepts & applications.
* Six Sigma Black belt preferred
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Office including Excel, Word, Outlook, and Access. NOTE! Must be proficient with charts & statistical formulas/templates in Excel.
Manager level Leadership knowledge/experience. 

*The Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer.*

new_roles.title: Director of Manufacturing Operations
new_roles.description:
Airlite Plastics is a premier, privately held, family-owned manufacturer headquartered in Omaha, Nebraska. Our family style and personal culture is what makes Airlite an amazing place to grow and build a successful career. Airlite’s company values of unquestionable integrity and respect and appreciation for each other are at the core of our success! These values set a strong foundation to build on where we can ‘wow’ our customers with innovative products and sustainable solutions and continuously improve our processes and efficiencies.

 

Our product lines include rigid plastic containers and lids for food packaging and cosmetics, dry powder scoops, plastic drink cups, shipping containers, industrial strength insulated concrete forms (ICF) and sustainable permeable paving systems. As pioneers in our industry, focused on sustainable solutions, we strive to provide our customers with top-notch service and quality, which aligns with our award-winning products.

 

As Airlite continues to grow and expand, we are excited to add new roles across our organization to support increasing customer demand and future innovation. This is an exciting time to join our team and be part of a company investing in people, technology, and long-term success.

 

**How would you contribute?**

This role is a contributing member of our team located in Nazareth, PA. As a Director of Operations you are a key to continued growth and success of Airlite. The Director of Operations provides strategic and operational leadership for manufacturing operations across assigned Airlite Locations. This role is responsible for Production, Maintenance, and Engineering and ensures operational strategies, resources, and priorities are aligned with business objectives.

This role will drive operational excellence through strong leadership, development of site leadership teams, continuous improvement, effective use of performance metrics, and disciplined execution. A key focus of this position is building leadership capability throughout the organization by coaching and developing managers and supervisors as the operations continue to grow and evolve. The Director will balance consistent operational expectations across locations while recognizing the unique needs and autonomy of each facility.

**Essential Duties:**

* Provide strategic leadership and direction for Production, Maintenance, and Engineering across the Nazareth and Lakeville facilities.

* Lead, coach, and develop operational leaders, strengthening leadership capability, accountability, decision-making, and succession readiness throughout the organization.

* Establish operational priorities, goals, and KPIs and use performance data to drive accountability and continuous improvement.

* Ensure manufacturing operations consistently achieve objectives related to safety, quality, delivery, productivity, efficiency, and cost.

* Partner with site leadership to develop and execute operational plans that support business growth, capacity requirements, equipment needs, and organizational objectives.

* Drive continuous improvement initiatives that improve manufacturing processes, equipment reliability, labor effectiveness, throughput, and overall operational performance.

* Provide leadership for capital projects, equipment installations, process improvements, and other operational initiatives in partnership with Engineering and Maintenance.

new_roles.title: Director, Filling & Assembly
new_roles.description:
At Revlon, we create beauty innovations for everyone that inspire confidence and ignite joy every day.

Breaking beauty boundaries is in our company's DNA. Since its game-changing launch of the first opaque nail enamel in 1932 (and later, the first long-wear foundation), Revlon has provided consumers with high-quality product innovation, performance, and sophisticated glamour. Elizabeth Arden made waves as a woman-led beauty company in the 1920s. In 1931, Almay became the original hypoallergenic, fragrance-free beauty brand.

Today, Revlon resiliently continues its legacy as a leading global beauty company. Our diverse portfolio—which consists of some of the world's most iconic brands and product offerings in color cosmetics, skincare, hair color & care, personal care, and fragrances—is sold around the world through prestige, professional, mass, and direct-to-consumer retail channels. These brands include Revlon, Revlon Professional, Elizabeth Arden, Almay, American Crew, CND, Cutex, Mitchum, Sinful Colors, Creme of Nature, Christina Aguilera, John Varvatos, Juicy Couture, Ed Hardy and more.

We honor our heritage, embrace change, and applaud diversity. We champion our employees and celebrate our consumers.

We are Revlon, together, transforming beauty.

**This role is an Onsite Role:** This role requires full-time presence at our Oxford, NC office.

**Overview:**

* Responsible for the safe and efficient operation of the Oxford Filling and Assembly operation – may include multiple cost centers (or all). Specific responsibilities include Ensuring that the workplace is safe, and employees work in a safe manner; Provide that all GMP requirements and regulations are complied with; Ensuring that all people issues and developmental needs are met; monitoring production requirements such that all customer needs are met on a timely basis; Responsible for all financial results of the operation.
* Act as a backup to the Vice President of Manufacturing (as needed) and the Oxford site General Manager (as needed). Be aware of any major issues/action underway in other cost centers / production areas in order to fill in as needed.

**Responsibilities:**

* **Safety:** Ensure that a safe workplace is maintained at all times. Provide resources necessary to be proactive towards addressing issues in the workplace. Comply with all OSHA & Revlon guidelines and procedures. Assist Safety Director as needed with task forces, projects and teams. Measures: Safety incident rate; OSHA & Workmen's comp rates; Revlon Safety Index.
* **People:** Strive to make the Oxford site a great place to work by: proactively developing people (cross training, class work and challenges); Addressing all issues, concerns and disciplinary actions promptly and effectively; contributing to site efforts to address issues and concerns. Measures: GPTW survey results; Developmental activity; providing challenges & changes to drive the organization forward.
* **GMP / Regulatory:** Ensure that all Revlon & Governmental Good Manufacturing Practices are complied with. Provide resources necessary to address any issues before the operation is adversely affected. Work with the site Quality Director (and others – as needed) to implement any new requirements due to new products or new regulations. Provide / facilitate training as needed. Ensure that all appropriate records are accurate and maintained within guidelines. Measures: First pass yields, rejection rates (domestic and international); GMP audit scores.
* **Customer Service:** Ensure that all Customer requirements (domestic, international & special markets) are met per company objectives (Regular business forecast & Promotional commitments). Evaluate production needs on a forward basis to ensure that needed equipment and people resources are available to meet the customer's needs. Measures: Schedule adherence; % Dollars shipped vs. ordered (CSL); performance to promotional ship on time commitments.
* **Financial:** Responsible for all financial aspects of the Filling and Assembly operation: Control of Labor – Direct (productive effort); Indirect (support effort); Nonstandard (Rework & First pass yield issues); Material – performance to established standards & minimization of waste; Overhead – effective utilization of management staff, supplies and ancillary equipment; Capital – effective, proactive utilization of installed equipment base, addressing capacity and new product needs with adequate lead time to meet customer's needs. Support and facilitate site cost reduction objectives. Measures: Labor – Direct efficiency, indirect % to earned, nonstandard % to earned; Material – MUV; Overhead – performance to budget & tasks.
* + Overhead – Supplies, executive staff, support labor – Up to $14 Million annually
 + Material – Value of material moved through the filling and assembly operation - $250 Million annually
 + Labor – Direct Labor managed in the filling and assembly operation - $30 Million annually

**Responsible for establishing processes to:**

* Ensure that all employees in the operation have defined job duties and expectations and are managed according to those duties – and that timely corrective action takes place when needed.
* Ensure that reasonable schedules are formulated, meeting customer's needs and equipment capability. Interface with appropriate departments as needed to affect change.
* Ensure that all equipment is operational and performs within expected tolerances.
* Ensure that all Revlon and governmental policies, guidelines, rules and procedures are followed and adhered to.
* Interface with all other sites functional areas as needed (HR, Quality, Distribution, Finance, etc.)

**Qualifications:**

* Extensive knowledge of production equipment, especially safe operating techniques, product capabilities and trouble-shooting methods
* Knowledge of planning / scheduling forecasting processes and systems
* Knowledge and experience with operations in an FDA – GMP environment
* Significant communication skills – verbal and written
* High level ability to analyze situations, and ability to facilitate cross functional teams
* Demonstrated success in people development and driving an organization forward
* Basic computer skills including Excel, Word, and use of MRP systems
* Prefer a 4-year degree in an engineering discipline, but other areas of study will be considered with appropriate and relevant experience
* Minimum 15 years of experience required
* Ability to make decisions
* Ability to effectively set and enforce company policy affecting up to 2,500 employees – communicate changes and issues to said group
* Significant operating knowledge of the Cosmetic industry – products, equipment and business practices
* Knowledge of Customer / Supplier relationships and how to best manage those to get results

Shift hours: 8:00am - 5:00pm

#LI-JL1

**Revlon is unable to sponsor or transfer employment visas for this role; candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States without current or future visa support.**

The base pay range for this position is $125,000 - $165,000 / year; however base pay offered may vary depending on skills, experience, job-related knowledge, and geographic location. Certain positions may also be eligible for short-term incentives as part of total compensation.

Employees (and their families) are eligible for medical, dental, and vision benefits. Employees are covered by the company-paid basic life insurance policy and company-paid short-term disability insurance (the benefit commences upon hire and allows for a portion of base salary for up to 26 weeks if you are disabled). Other benefits offered to employees include but are not limited to the following: long-term disability, supplemental life insurances, flexible spending accounts, critical illness insurance, group legal, identity theft protection, etc. Employees are also able to enroll in our 401k Retirement Savings Plan.

Employees will also receive 4 weeks of vacation, pro-rated based on date of hire for the 1st year of employment and twelve paid holidays throughout the calendar year. Vacation will depend on role.

new_roles.description:
**Company Description**

Table 87 Frozen LLC is a national frozen pizza manufacturer and “The Home Of The Coal Oven Slice.” Born in Brooklyn NY, founder Thomas Cucco opened his first slice shop in Brooklyn Heights in 2012. Today, Table 87 runs three authentic coal-oven pizza shops while operating its own vertically integrated frozen production facility that ships its signature frozen pizza nationwide. After national exposure on ABC’s Shark Tank, Table 87 has scaled into top retailers and distributors across the USA, bringing authentic Brooklyn NY coal-oven pizza to freezers everywhere.

**Role Description**

The Director of Operations, Frozen is a full-time, on-site role based in Brooklyn, NY. This role will own day-to-day operations of the Frozen Production Facility and drive consistent output across all frozen manufacturing. Core responsibilities include production leadership, packaging, staffing, inventory and supply-chain optimization, logistics expertise, food-safety elevation, and full facility/equipment readiness. Our mandate is clear: take a high-growth disruptor brand’s production operation and turn it into a dominant, scalable food-manufacturing engine. Success in this role is designed to evolve into COO.

**Qualifications**

* Proven track record evolving an emerging brand into advanced, large-scale manufacturing success
* Proven blend of entrepreneurial grit and disciplined management systems
* Operations leadership experience in food manufacturing or closely related industry
* Strong KPI ownership, demand forecasting, data-driven decision-making, and ERP proficiency
* Demonstrated ability to coach teams, manage performance, and collaborate cross-functionally
* Solid knowledge of food safety regulations, HACCP, and quality-assurance best practices
* Ideally experienced in developing and managing SQF certification
* Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma or similar mindset preferred
* Bachelor’s degree in Operations Management, Food Science, or related field preferred

Pay: $150,000.00 - $200,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Professional development assistance

Education:

* Bachelor's (Required)

Experience:

* Food Manufacturing: 10 years (Required)
* SQF: 5 years (Required)
* Lean Manufacturing (Six Sigma): 3 years (Preferred)
* ERP systems: 1 year (Preferred)

Ability to Commute:

* Brooklyn, NY 11232 (Required)

Work Location: In person

new_roles.description:
**Work Schedule**

Standard (Mon-Fri)

**Environmental Conditions**

Office

**Job Description**

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

**LOCATION**: Currently tied to Morrisville, NC (may be open to other locations). Relocation assistance is NOT provided.

* Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.
* Must be able to pass a comprehensive background check, which includes a drug screening.

**DESCRIPTION**:

As a Senior Director of Operations at Thermo Fisher Scientific, you'll manage complex manufacturing operations while driving strategic growth and operational excellence. This key leadership role involves directing production of high-quality products in regulated environments while ensuring exceptional customer service and compliance. You'll optimize end-to-end operations, implement continuous improvement initiatives, and develop high-performing teams aligned with our mission of enabling customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer.

Working closely with cross-functional partners, you'll establish and execute strategic plans, drive productivity and efficiency improvements, and support a culture focused on quality, safety and customer success. This role requires strong business acumen to manage P&L responsibilities while scaling operations to meet growing demand. You'll support our PPI (Practical Process Improvement) business system and 4i values - Integrity, Intensity, Innovation and Involvement - while developing talent and building engaged, collaborative teams.

**REQUIREMENTS**:

* Advanced Degree plus 6 years of experience, or Bachelor's Degree plus 8 years of experience in operations leadership in regulated manufacturing environments
* Preferred Fields of Study: Engineering, Chemistry, Biology, Business or related technical/scientific field
* Advanced training in continuous improvement methodologies (Six Sigma, Lean)
* Demonstrated P&L management and operational excellence experience at scale
* Strong working knowledge of cGMP, FDA, and other relevant quality/regulatory requirements
* Experience leading and developing large, multi-functional teams
* Experience implementing continuous improvement and lean manufacturing methodologies
* Strong business acumen and analytical capabilities
* Effective communication and influence skills across all organizational levels
* Ability to implement change and deliver results in matrix environments
* Experience with ERP systems and manufacturing technologies
* Strong project management capabilities
* Strategic mindset with ability to balance short and long-term priorities
* Experience in customer/client relationship management
* Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities
* Ability to travel 50-75% as required
* Change management and transformation experience
* Cross-functional collaboration and influence skills
* Financial planning and budget management expertise

We offer competitive remuneration, annual incentive plan bonus scheme, healthcare, company 401k, and a range of employee benefits! Thermo Fisher Scientific offers employment with an innovative, forward-thinking organization, and outstanding career and development prospects. We offer an exciting company culture that stands for integrity, intensity, involvement, and innovation.

Thermo Fisher Scientific is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and does not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided a reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform critical job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request an accommodation.

new_roles.title: Director of Engineering (Food Manufacturing Plants)
new_roles.description:
**Director of Engineering (Food Manufacturing)**

Dessert Holdings is the leading premium dessert company in the world. We craft artisanal, scratch-made desserts at scale, combining culinary innovation with the finest real ingredients. With a rich heritage spanning seven distinctive brands, we bring unmatched expertise and tailored solutions to our Retail and Foodservice partners.

Dessert Holdings is looking for a **Director of Engineering**to be based in **Aurora, CO** or ideally near one of our production facilities, who will travel as needed to sites for projects. Under the direction of the VP of Engineering & Reliability and in coordination with Corporate and Site Management teams, this individual will provide technical and professional leadership for project management and engineering across Dessert Holdings' tenFood Manufacturing Plants. This role is responsible for capital projects and for identifying, vetting, and championing new manufacturing opportunities and new or emerging technical advancements. This position requires strong personal initiative to identify opportunities, achieve engineering standardization, and implement asset and process best practices within the Dessert Holdings manufacturing facilities.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Provide engineering counsel and leadership for multiple facilities and internal and external project engineers.
* Manage and execute all facets of Dessert Holdings capital projects such as building expansions, and capacity expansion including brownfield and greenfield projects.
* Identify and champion cost reduction projects (capital and non-capital) through process or equipment improvements, capital automation, and robotic opportunities.
* Define technology and manufacturing capabilities to support new business and line extensions.
* Aid with developing 3/5-Year Capital Plan, including originating capital appropriation requests, developing project schedules and work teams, writing of contracts, coordinating project activities, controlling project funds, and implementing startup/training procedures as necessary.
* Write capital projects that include preparation of studies, proposals, estimates, technical reports, capital required, cash flow on approved CEA format.
* Assist in the development and implementation of new facility planning and construction. Includes developing packages, creating equipment and construction specifications, establishing and tracking project budgets, utility utilization, EPA and OSHA requirements, knowledge of GMP's, writing and justifying projects.
* Administer project bid documents and assist with rewarding contracts to outside vendors, architects, and engineers.
* Create and maintain the appropriate engineering records including equipment records and manuals, drawings and diagrams, inspection reports and legal records as required by the appropriate agencies.
* Maintain effective reporting and communication with the appropriate people both within and outside of the plant.
* Work closely with outside agencies in their respective fields, i.e., OSHA, EPA, FDA, etc., to ensure plant compliance with current regulations.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering required or equivalent technical degree. Substantial applicable experience will also be considered.
* 10-15 years of engineering leadership with progressive technical and/or management experience including project management and extensive food manufacturing experience
* Ability to travel up to 75%, throughout the US (8 sites) and Canada (2 sites)
* Hands on approach to problem solving with creative solutions and ability to handle ambiguity
* Strong oral and written communication skills
* Understand business implications of decisions, align work with strategic goals
* Ability to prioritize and plan work activities, set goals, timelines, and objectives
* Display original thinking, creativity and resourcefulness to generate innovative approaches and ideas
* Ability to create and drive automation opportunities including robotic manufacturing capability
* Possess leadership skills and the ability to effectively manage and communicate with engineers, construction personnel, project managers, clients and executives
* Demonstrated proficiency in Word, Excel, Gantt, Power Point, AutoCAD, and project planners
* Familiarity with controls, process, packaging, electrical, mechanical, refrigeration systems
