new_roles.title: Director of Chemistry, Small Molecule Process Development and Manufacturing
new_roles.description:
**About This Role**
 
We are seeking a highly motivated and creative Director of Chemistry to join our Small Molecule Chemical Development team. In this role, you will lead and mentor scientific and engineering teams as you guide project progression from early-phase through late-phase drug development. You will oversee the design and refinement of robust manufacturing processes for a wide range of small molecules, supporting pre - clinical and clinical therapeutics. This role is integral to advancing our scientific endeavors, driving innovation, and enabling the successful launch of new medicines through collaborative, safe, economical, and sustainable process development.

**Who We Are**

We are a team of organic chemists and chemical engineers engaged in the design of innovative processes which supply new medicines to patients. We focus on developing safe, economical, sustainable, cost - effective , and robust processes to support clinical trials and the launch of new medicines across various drug modalities. We are driven by first principles science, data-driven decision-making, and collaborative teamwork.

**What** **You’ll****Do**

* Lead c ollaborat ive development and manufacturing teams to design and conduct experiments to optimize and characterize the processes of Biogen assets with an emphasis on improvement in process understanding, robustness, and productivity.

* D esign, guide and execute experimental plans to advance the Biogen portfolio. You will be responsible for leading project teams towards the implementation of safe, efficient and robust chemical processes Biogen drug candidates. You will c ollaborate with development and manufacturing teams to optimize and characterize the processes of Biogen assets with an emphasis on improvement in process understanding, robustness, and productivity.

* Responsible for managing scientific colleagues, and mentoring, engaging, and preparing our future scientific and engineering leaders

* Develop the fundamental process knowledge needed to support the transition of chemical and biochemical processes from laboratory scale to manufacturing partners.

* Collaborate with our Process Engineering, Analytical Chemistry, Oligo Synthesis, Solid Form, and Separations colleagues to develop the knowledge and controls needed for the supply of clinical materials and characterization of processes to support regulatory filings.

* Communicate project team research results effectively by in reports and discussions in team meetings , including e ngage ment in CMC activities including authoring CMC section of INDs.

* Interact with Contract Research Organizations as project needs evolve , which may include travel

* Initiate innovative research projects to improve fundamental understanding and control of Biogen processes

* Expand on your Chemistry community presence professionally representing Biogen externally in consortia and conferences

**Who You Are**

You have a passion for exploring scientific concepts and are eager to contribute to the design and development and execution of cutting-edge technologies in the service of delivering drug cand idates for clinical trials . Your vision and dedication drive you to push the boundaries of scientific endeavors, ultimately impacting patient lives. You thrive in a collaborative environment where urgency, accountability, inclusion and integrity are shared value s .

* M.S. or PhD with 12 + years of relevant experience , including people management, in pharmaceutical or biotech settings is required

* Strong background in the theory and practice of pharmaceutical process chemistry and engineering , including command of synthetic strategies, impurity controls, analytical, purification and isolation techniques, process characterization , familiarity with process safety and tech transfer protocols, and good problem -s olving skills in the service of delivering non-clinical and clinical APIs and the phase appropriate knowledge packages for CMC support.

* Demonstrated experience in leading project teams involved in delivery of APIs across several modalities

* Ability to lead teams ethically, collaboratively , effectively, and cross-functionally

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills are required along with the desire to work in a highly collaborative team environment .

**Preferred Skills:**

* Experience in engaging with external partners and representing the organization in external facing settings.

* Familiarity with regulatory requirements and CMC activities related to drug development.

 
Job Level: Management 

**Additional Information**

The base compensation range for this role is: $188,000.00-$258,500.00 

Base salary offered is determined through an analytical approach utilizing a combination of factors including, but not limited to, relevant skills & experience, job location, and internal equity.

 

Regular employees are eligible to receive both short term and long-term incentives, including cash bonus and equity incentive opportunities, designed to reward recent achievements and recognize your future potential based on individual, business unit and company performance.

 
 

In addition to compensation, Biogen offers a full and highly competitive range of benefits designed to support our employees’ and their families *physical, financial, emotional,* and *social well-being* ; including, but not limited to:

* Medical, Dental, Vision, & Life insurances
* Fitness & Wellness programs including a fitness reimbursement
* Short- and Long-Term Disability insurance
* A minimum of 15 days of paid vacation and an additional end-of-year shutdown time off (Dec 26-Dec 31)
* Up to 12 company paid holidays + 3 paid days off for Personal Significance
* 80 hours of sick time per calendar year
* Paid Maternity and Parental Leave benefit
* 401(k) program participation with company matched contributions
* Employee stock purchase plan
* Tuition reimbursement of up to $10,000 per calendar year
* Employee Resource Groups participation
 

 

**Why Biogen?**

We are a global team with a commitment to excellence, and a pioneering spirit. As a mid-sized biotechnology company, we provide the stability and resources of a well-established business while fostering an environment where individual contributions make a significant impact. Our team encompasses some of the most talented and passionate achievers who have unparalleled opportunities for learning, growth, and expanding their skills. Above all, we work together to deliver life-changing medicines, with every role playing a vital part in our mission. Caring Deeply. Achieving Excellence. Changing Lives.

 
 

At Biogen, we are committed to building on our culture of inclusion and belonging that reflects the communities where we operate and the patients we serve. We know that diverse backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives make us a stronger and more innovative company, and we are focused on building teams where every employee feels empowered and inspired.

 
 

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital status, race, color, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, religion, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law. Biogen is an E-Verify Employer in the United States.

new_roles.description:
**Join Komatsu and Be Part of Something Big!**

**Job Overview**
----------------

Planning, organizing, leading and controlling all manufacturing related activities of TimberPro Inc. (TPI). Responsible for the performance of departmental functions: Manufacturing, Materials Management, Quality Assurance, Production Planning, CapEx Planning, Human Resources, Facilities Management and supporting Manufacturing Engineering.

**Key Job Responsibilities**
----------------------------

* Develops, reviews, and approves operating plans to achieve production and financial objectives, with accountability for budget control, labor and material efficiency, customer service, order fulfillment, employee relations, and effective workforce utilization.
* Manages Material Resource Planning (MRP), including inventory planning, accuracy, control, and optimization. Coordinates with major suppliers to ensure accurate forecasting, appropriate inventory levels, and reliable component availability to meet production requirements and future capacity expansion.
* Monitors performance against operating plans and standards, communicates results, identifies areas requiring corrective action, and recommends adjustments to achieve operational objectives.
* Develops and presents monthly performance reports as requested by Executive management.
* Develops and implements local policies and procedures consistent with corporate standards, regulatory requirements, OSHA standards, and Komatsu safety requirements, ensuring compliance and a strong safety culture.
* Establishes plant operating objectives and develops short- and long-term plans, budgets, financial forecasts, and resource requirements to achieve business goals.
* Provides oversight for plant cost control, cost forecasting, workforce planning, and facility and capacity requirements, identifying risks and implementing actions to achieve operational and financial objectives.
* Reviews and approves the development and review of all TPI manufacturing budgets.
* Manages facility contracts and third-party service providers, including material disposal, plant and facility maintenance, uniforms, and other site services, ensuring cost, service, and compliance performance.
* Oversees plant budgeting, reviews departmental budget proposals, monitors spending, and authorizes expenditures within established approval limits.
* Reviews and approves major projects involving functional changes within TPI.
* Leads identification and implementation of new manufacturing technologies, automation, processes, and capabilities supporting TimberPro’s long-term operational strategy. Collaborates across Komatsu manufacturing operations to leverage best practices, technical expertise, and solutions that drive improvement in safety, quality, delivery, cost, and productivity.
* Consults with management responsible for policy or action, ensures compliance within areas of responsibility, and recommends improvements to policies and procedures.
* Establishes objectives and procedures governing assigned activities. Issues annual objectives to immediate subordinates and reviews objectives of TPI management.
* Builds and maintains an effective plant leadership team through selection, development, coaching, and retention of qualified personnel. Ensures clear roles, responsibilities, and accountability and supports compensation, training, performance management, and succession planning.
* Leads and evaluates direct reports, coordinates activities across functions, identifies training and development needs, and takes appropriate personnel actions to ensure organizational performance.
* Maintains effective communication with employees at all plant levels, providing clear direction, timely feedback, and visibility to business priorities and operational performance.
* Ensures coordination across plant functions and other company organizations, resolving cross-functional issues related to new product development, workers’ compensation, inventory control, and operational performance.
* Performs other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications/Requirements**
-------------------------------

* Bachelor’s Degree Manufacturing, Engineering or Business Required. MBA or Masters in Engineering or Manufacturing preferred.
* Minimum 3 years’ experience as a GM of Operations in Manufacturing or similar experience.
* Sound administrative skills, well-developed management skills – principles and people.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to effectively communicate across all functions of the organization.
* Working experience in union and non-union environments.
* Experience with Material Management – Bills of Materials, Sourcing, Purchasing, and Inventory Management.
* Experience with new product development and transitioning those products into production.
* Proven ability to recruit, train, and motivate personnel in order to gain profitability and strengthen the organization.
* Honest and trustworthy toward all members of the organization. Use discretion on matters of confidentiality.
* Portray an optimistic and positive attitude in dealings with peers and subordinates.

**Company Benefits**

Komatsu provides an extensive and robust employee benefits package that is designed to enhance the well-being of our employees and family members. We embrace a positive and empowering employee experience with a culture that prides itself on a diverse and inclusive environment.

* Health benefits: Medical, dental, vision, HSA, wellness programs, etc.
* 401k and/or employee savings programs
* Employee time off (vacation and designated holidays)
* Employee and family assistance programs
* Disability benefits
* Life insurance
* Employee learning and development programs

**Diversity & Inclusion Commitment**

At Komatsu, we come from diverse backgrounds, with unique perspectives, experiences, and contributions. We are committed to creating a workforce that is reflective of the communities we work and live in. We believe that our people are part of our shared purpose. Connected by our core values of ambition, perseverance, collaboration and authenticity, we are committed to continually advancing in our support of diversity and inclusion. United, we are on a journey towards a sustainable future that creates value together.

**Company Information**

Komatsu develops and supplies technologies, equipment and services for the construction, mining, forklift, industrial and forestry markets. Headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, Komatsu employs more than 64,000 people worldwide, operating in more than 140 countries. For more than a century, the company has been creating value for its customers through manufacturing and technology innovation, partnering with others to empower a sustainable future where people, business and the planet thrive together. Since the company’s founding in 1921, Komatsu has been committed to supporting individuals and communities through job training, skills development and giving back. As a Komatsu employee, you will be encouraged to grow alongside our global company, contributing to a more sustainable future for all. If you are looking for a company that values your talent and potential, join Komatsu to be a part of something big and help advance modern society. Learn more at www.komatsu.com.

**EEO Statement**

Komatsu is an Equal Opportunity Workplace and an Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

new_roles.title: Plant Manager
new_roles.description:
Dairy Farmers of America (DFA), a dairy marketing cooperative owned by more than 12,500 family farmers. Our mark matters and it represents the wholesomeness of dairy that we share with our communities and loved ones. DFA manufactures a variety of dairy products, including cheese, butter, fluid milk, ice cream, dairy ingredients and more, under well-known and established regional brands. Our fingerprints touch thousands of brands across the marketplace, and we're passionate about delivering the simple pleasures of dairy to people everywhere, straight from our family farm-owners. We are proud to provide families with fresh delicious dairy products.

By joining DFA, you can help us continue to make a difference that matters. We care deeply about the well-being of our neighbors and friends, and we celebrate the diversity of our company and our world. It takes an incredible team to deliver the goodness of dairy and enrich our communities – come join us!

**GENERAL PURPOSE**

Direct and coordinate overall plant operations and priorities, and through managers, supervisors, and staff, ensure product is produced efficiently and within cost parameters. Provide work direction to management and employees within the guidelines of standard work rules, union contract provisions (if applicable), and employment policies. Is held accountable for achieving the plant's key performance indicators. Support the Continuous Improvement (CI) initiative to improve productivity, quality, efficiency of operations, and the facility's culture. Manage the overall operating budget including capital and expense projects. Direct personnel activities of department, such as recruitment, hiring, performance evaluations, and salary adjustments using independent judgment within the framework of established human resources policies and practices.

This plant manager job is a single incumbent role responsible for multiple plants or a large and/or complex plant that may also have an assistant plant manager(s) within the plant.

**JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Manage plant operations in all areas of responsibility including administration, production, processing, packaging, quality, maintenance, warehousing, shipping, purchasing, safety, and environmental

* Establish production priorities to ensure product is produced efficiently and within cost parameters while maintaining safety, quality and sanitation standards; obtain optimum production and utilization of workforce, machines, and equipment

* Review and analyze production, quality control, maintenance, and operational reports to ensure compliance and determine causes of non-conformity with product specifications, customer requirements, FDA/government regulations, etc. Report any non-compliance immediately per established protocol

* Analyze plant operations to ensure that the facility maintains a leadership position in the industry and that it takes advantage of new processes and technologies that become available

* Interact with customers to meet their expectations on a variety of goals including operational, customer service, financial, and quality

* Develop, monitor, and drive plant key performance indicators (KPI's) related to safety, quality, productivity and finances. Strive for continuous improvement in KPI results. Promote continuous improvement culture and activities

* Understand plant P&L to drive plant performance; participate in the development of annual operating, capital and expense budgets; provide reliable and accurate information to finance to meet end-of-month closing schedules

* Manage or oversee all corporate, customer, and government audits to ensure compliance

* Conduct meetings with management and staff to ensure all operational issues are being communicated and addressed expediently with a common understanding of goals

* Communicate company goals and assist in establishing objectives that align with plant and company goals; communicate plant direction, focus and goals

* Provide appropriate direction, mentoring, training, and development planning for managers. Identify and retain highly effective personnel through proper selection, training and task assignment. Actively work with direct reports to cultivate capabilities and utilize strengths to support career development and succession planning efforts

* Maintain safe working conditions for employees and compliance with all company, state and federal regulations regarding health and safety issues

* Follow all DFA good manufacturing practices (GMP) and work in a manner consistent with all company regulatory, food safety, quality, and sanitation requirements

* The requirements herein are intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed by employee, but is not a complete list of responsibilities, duties, and skills required. Other duties may be assigned as required

**BENEFITS:**

new_roles.title: Plant Manager
new_roles.description:
**What you’ll do:**
-------------------

Eaton's Electrical Sector Americas - ARS/Fibrebond division is currently seeking a Plant Manager for its manufacturing operations in Minden, Louisiana. This role is a critical member of the site leadership team and is responsible for leading safe, high-quality, on-time, and cost-effective operations. Relocation assistance is available to candidates currently residing in the U.S. 
 
In this role, you will lead the Minden manufacturing site and its leadership team. You will drive strategic and operational initiatives including plant P&L, growth strategy, capacity, execution, and the direction of the team to meet and exceed short- and long-term business goals. You will foster an environment of engagement and inclusion for all employees and act with advocacy, empathy, and accountability. 
 
Fibrebond, an Eaton company, designs and manufactures pre-integrated modular buildings and power enclosures that protect mission-critical equipment for data center, industrial, utility, and communications customers. Headquartered in Minden, Louisiana, Fibrebond is known for its engineered-to-order solutions that support complex infrastructure projects across North America. In 2025, Fibrebond was acquired by Eaton, expanding Eaton's modular solutions portfolio while preserving Fibrebond's strong engineering expertise, customer focus, and manufacturing operations in Louisiana. 
 
**What you’ll need:** 

* Develop short- and long-term plans in alignment with the strategic plan and annual profit plan objectives to drive superior operational performance and financial results.
* Lead the operational management team and functional staff including Quality, OPEX, EHS and Supply Chain.
* Establish objectives and drive Key Performance Indicators across the organization ensuring continuous improvement.
* Emphasize utilization of Lean/Six Sigma manufacturing tools (Kaizen, VSM, 5S+) to lead cost improvement
* Establish and manage inventory to profit plan, driving improved and sustainable processes; execute the Supply Demand Planning (SIOP), drive ownership and collaboration across all stakeholder groups; generate forecasts that meet customer expectations.
* Champion a workplace focused on Environmental, Health & Safety (EHS) to drive a zero-incident safety culture.
* Focus on Quality, early detection and escalations across the site to reduce cost, drive efficiency and ensure compliance.
* Create a culture of exceeding customer expectations, ensuring that the organization is highly responsive to customer needs.
* Demonstrate the ability to be innovative by developing and implementing creative solutions to complex problems, fostering a culture of innovation and continuously seeking opportunities for improvement.
* Partner with Human Resources to drive talent management, learning, communication, and development strategies.
* Champion and advocate for a winning plant culture aligned with the Eaton Culture Model

**Qualifications:**
-------------------

**Required Qualifications:** 

* Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited institution
* 10+ years of experience with progressive levels of accountability and responsibility in roles focused on manufacturing, supply chain, finance, OPEX and/or related support functions in a manufacturing environment.
* 5+ years of people-management experience
* Must be able to travel as business needs require.
* Eaton will not consider applicants for employment immigration sponsorship or support for this position.This means that Eaton will not support any CPT, OPT, or STEM OPT plans, F-1 to H-1B, H-1B cap registration, O-1, E-3, TN status, I-485 job portability, etc.

 
**Preferred Qualifications:** 

* MBA from an accredited institution
* Previous experience leading a complex engineered-to-order manufacturing operation through growth, capacity expansion, operational transformation.
* Plant P&L leadership experience with strong business acumen.
* 3+ years of experience as a leader of leaders.

**Additional Information**
--------------------------

* This role will be based at our Fibrebond manufacturing plant in Minden, LA.
* Relocation will be offered for this position.

All positions may require participation in video and in-person interviews as part of the hiring process. All candidates will be evaluated based on job-related competencies, and all candidates’ privacy rights and data security will be protected in accordance with applicable laws.

At Eaton, we strive to provide compensation and benefits that attract, engage, and retain the best talent. This includes competitive pay and a variety of benefit programs for eligible employees. The expected annual salary range for this role is $182000 - $266000 a year. This role is also eligible for a variable incentive program. *Please note the salary information shown above is a general guideline only. Salaries are based upon candidate skills, experience, and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.*

We are committed to ensuring equal employment opportunities for all job applicants and employees. Employment decisions are based upon job-related reasons regardless of an applicant's race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, marital status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by law.

Eaton believes in second chance employment. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction history will be considered regardless of their arrest or conviction history, consistent with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, the California Fair Chance Act and other local laws.

You do not need to disclose your conviction history or participate in a background check until a conditional job offer is made to you. After making a conditional offer and running a background check, if Eaton is concerned about conviction that is directly related to the job, you will be given the chance to explain the circumstances surrounding the conviction, provide mitigating evidence, or challenge the accuracy of the background report.

To request a disability-related reasonable accommodation to assist you in your job search, application, or interview process, please call us at 1-800-836-6345 to discuss your specific need. Only accommodation requests will be accepted by this phone number.

We know that good benefit programs are important to employees and their families. Eaton provides various Health and Welfare benefits as well as Retirement benefits, and several programs that provide for paid and unpaid time away from work. Click here for more detail: Eaton Benefits Overview. Please note that specific programs and options available to an employee may depend on eligibility factors such as geographic location, date of hire, and the applicability of collective bargaining agreements.

**Position Summary:**

* We are conducting a confidential search for a Plant Manager with a well-established industrial manufacturer in the Tulsa area.
* This leader will oversee a concrete production operation and have direct influence over safety, quality, production performance, and the people who make it happen.
* The company is seeking an experienced, hands-on leader who can set expectations, develop teams, and produce consistent results.

**What You Will Lead:**

* Safety first, always. Establish and maintain a proactive safety culture through field presence, training, hazard recognition, and accountability.
* Lead daily plant production, scheduling, staffing, equipment readiness, output, and on-time fulfillment.
* Own quality control and product consistency, including adherence to customer specifications and internal manufacturing standards.
* Oversee concrete manufacturing processes such as batching, reinforcement, forming and molds, casting, curing, handling, and finished-product inspection.
* Coach supervisors, leads, and hourly employees; develop talent and improve workforce performance, engagement, and accountability.
* Partner with maintenance, engineering, and logistics to reduce downtime, rework, waste, and process bottlenecks.

**What We Are Looking For:**

* Demonstrated success leading manufacturing operations with direct accountability for workplace safety, quality, production, and labor.
* Strong practical experience in concrete manufacturing is highly preferred; reinforced concrete pipe, culverts, drainage structures, manholes, inlets, vaults, or related products are especially relevant.
* Knowledge of production processes, quality inspections, equipment, maintenance coordination, and continuous improvement.
* Proven ability to lead frontline teams, strengthen supervisors, and solve operational problems on the plant floor.
* Clear communication, sound judgment, and the ability to balance production goals with uncompromising safety standards.
* Bilingual English and Spanish skills are a significant plus, but not a requirement.

**Compensation and Location:**

* Tulsa, Oklahoma area; the role requires on-site plant leadership.
* Competitive compensation commensurate with substantial operating experience. Final base salary, bonus, and benefits details will be discussed during the screening process.
* Qualified candidates outside the region are welcome to inquire; relocation is open for the right person. Assistance details are subject to confirmation.

**Interested in a Confidential Conversation:**

new_roles.title: Plant Manager
new_roles.description:
**Plant Manager – Furniture Manufacturing**

**Position Summary**

We are seeking an experienced, hands-on, and results-driven **Plant Manager** to lead our furniture manufacturing operations. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced manufacturing leader to take ownership of plant performance, develop a strong leadership team, improve production processes, and make a direct impact on the success and growth of the facility.

The Plant Manager will oversee all aspects of plant operations, including production, safety, quality, scheduling, cost management, and employee development. This individual will provide leadership and oversight to department supervisors across the facility, ensuring all departments work together to achieve production, quality, safety, and operational goals.

The ideal candidate is a strong, people-focused leader with a solid manufacturing background who knows how to motivate teams, develop supervisors, improve processes, solve problems, and create a culture of accountability, teamwork, safety, and quality.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Plant Operations & Production**

* Direct and oversee daily manufacturing operations to ensure production goals, quality standards, and delivery expectations are consistently met.
* Coordinate activities across departments to maximize productivity, efficiency, and workflow.
* Identify and implement process improvements to reduce waste, control labor costs, and increase operational efficiency.
* Develop and monitor production goals, performance metrics, and operational procedures.
* Oversee equipment needs, maintenance coordination, and resource planning to support production demands.

**Leadership & Employee Development**

* Provide overall leadership, direction, and oversight to department supervisors across all areas of the manufacturing plant.
* Lead, coach, and develop supervisors to ensure effective management of their respective departments and teams.
* Establish clear performance expectations, goals, and accountability for department supervisors.
* Monitor departmental performance and work with supervisors to address challenges, improve productivity, and achieve production goals.
* Oversee employee training and development initiatives to build a skilled, productive workforce.
* Promote teamwork, communication, and collaboration between departments to ensure smooth and efficient plant operations.
* Foster a positive work environment focused on employee engagement, accountability, safety, quality, and continuous improvement.

**Cost Management & Financial Performance**

* Develop and manage plant budgets while maintaining effective cost controls.
* Identify opportunities to reduce labor and production costs without sacrificing quality or safety.
* Implement and maintain production cost tracking systems to evaluate manufacturing performance.
* Monitor labor utilization, productivity, and operating expenses to support profitability.

**Safety & Quality**

* Promote a safe working environment and ensure employees follow established safety procedures.
* Maintain high standards for product quality and accuracy throughout the manufacturing process.
* Monitor production processes and implement improvements to reduce defects, waste, and product returns.
* Ensure the facility has the necessary supplies, equipment, and resources to maintain safe and efficient operations.

**Systems & Process Improvement**

* Work closely with office personnel to improve administrative processes, reporting systems, and documentation.
* Establish and maintain effective production records and reporting procedures.
* Stay current with manufacturing technology, equipment, and industry best practices.
* Support improvements to systems and processes that enhance product quality, operational efficiency, and customer service.
* Perform other duties as needed to support the success of plant operations.

**Qualifications & Experience**

**Required Qualifications:**

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Minimum of 5 years of manufacturing, production, scheduling, or operations experience.
* Minimum of 3 years of leadership or supervisory experience in a manufacturing environment.
* Demonstrated ability to lead supervisors and teams, manage performance, and drive operational results.
* Strong problem-solving, organizational, communication, and decision-making skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* 5–7 years of manufacturing operations or production management experience.
* Previous Plant Manager, Operations Manager, Production Manager, or similar leadership experience.
* Experience in furniture manufacturing or a similar production environment.
* Experience managing multiple departments and supervising department leaders.
* Experience managing production costs, labor efficiency, budgets, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Manufacturing, Operations Management, or a related field is a plus, but equivalent hands-on experience will be considered.

**Key Skills & Competencies**

* Strong leadership and team-building skills.
* Employee development and performance management.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong time management and organizational abilities.
* Manufacturing and operational knowledge.
* Results-oriented mindset.
* Problem-solving and continuous improvement.
* Attention to detail and accountability.

**What We Offer**

We value our employees and offer a benefits package designed to support their health, financial well-being, and work-life balance.

* Health Insurance available after 90 days.
* 401(k) retirement plan available after one year.
* Paid vacation.
* Additional company benefits.

**Work Environment & Physical Requirements**

This position operates in a furniture manufacturing facility. The work environment may include exposure to airborne particles, fumes, moving mechanical equipment, vibration, and elevated noise levels.

The position requires frequent standing, walking, reaching, and use of hands. Occasional sitting, climbing, balancing, bending, kneeling, crouching, and crawling may be required.

The ability to regularly lift or move up to 10 pounds and occasionally lift or move up to 25 pounds is required. Specific vision requirements include close, distance, color, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

new_roles.title: Sr. Director Operational Excellence
new_roles.description:
**Company Description**

At **Link Snacks**, we show up hungry, roll up our sleeves, plaid or otherwise, and dive straight into the hard work. We don’t hide from challenges; we hunt them down. We push harder, move faster, and take the kinds of big swings that built this business in the North Woods of Wisconsin four decades ago.

We’re everyday people who deliver extraordinary results. Innovation, creativity, and urgency aren’t buzzwords, they’re expectations. And just like the real protein snacks we make across our global house of brands—Jack Link’s®*,* Lorissa’s Kitchen®*,* Golden Island®*,* BiFi®*, and* Peperami® *and* KOOEE!® to name a few—there’s nothing artificial about us. What you see is exactly what you get: humble, gritty, passionate people who show up every day ready to not just be a participate in the meat snack industry that the Link Family created, but to move faster, innovate harder and keep raising the bar so high, the rest of the world needs a ladder just to see it.

Dominating this space across the world takes a team. A team that runs together, succeeds together, and celebrates together. A team that’s full of relentless energy and spirit that can only be fueled by one thing: a fist full of our delicious meat snacks.

Real Meat Protein. Real People. Real Results. THAT is Link Snacks.

 **Job Description**

**JOB SUMMARY**

The Sr Director of Operational Excellence leads the company's continuous improvement strategy across all manufacturing sites. This role will build the process, capabilities, tools, and governance necessary to create a consistent and sustainable approach to continuous improvement across all factories. The Sr Director will establish a standardized manufacturing excellence framework grounded in lean principles, structured problem solving, loss elimination, standard work, and performance management.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Lead the CI change effort. Develop and lead the company’s Continuous Improvement strategy and roadmap across all factories.
* Establish a common CI methodology, tools, governance, terminology, and expectations across the manufacturing network.
* Establish common standards for Lean practices, structured problem solving, daily management, standard work, and performance improvement.
* Establish and advance Lean manufacturing practices including standard work, Kaizen, 5S, value-stream mapping, visual management, root-cause analysis, waste elimination, centerlining, and structured problem solving.
* Develop CI training, tools, playbooks and learning programs.
* Develop a network of plant-level Continuous Improvement champions to accelerate adoption and share knowledge.
* Manage performance. Work with the Plant Leadership Team to track plant targets and KPIs regularly and set action plans and follow-up meetings to close gaps.
* Own KPI visibility. Manage the daily, weekly, and monthly KPI charting and posting process to keep teams accountable.
* Simplify data. Use Power BI and SAP to turn complex operational data into clear, usable information for plant and operations leaders.
* Apply analytics. Use statistics and other analytical methods to identify improvement opportunities and support decisions.
* Track savings. Implement and manage a cost savings tracking process aligned with corporate standards and deliver against savings targets.
* Partner on safety. Partner with the Safety Director to embed safety into improvement work, including incident investigation, hazard reduction, and safety considerations in kaizen events.
* Perform other duties as assigned

 
**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in operations, manufacturing, supply chain, business, engineering, food science, or related field, or equivalent experience in continuous improvement.
* 7 to 10 years experience in a manufacturing environment, including a leadership role.
* 5+ years in influencing roles, such as CI, Lean, or support functions.
* Experience or education in statistical process control, root cause analysis, or other analytical methods.
* Training and hands-on experience with value stream mapping, kaizen methods, 5S, leader standard work, and other Lean tools.
* Project management experience leading cross-functional teams to deliver on timelines, budgets, and goals.
* Experience developing or implementing a playbook for a management operating system (MOS) and a continuous improvement program, including how the playbook was rolled out across sites.

**Preferred**

* Experience with SAP and Power BI for operational reporting.
* Experience in food or consumer packaged goods manufacturing.
* Experience with Total Productive Maintenance (TPM), with at least working exposure to its Autonomous Maintenance (AM) and Planned Maintenance (PM) pillars.

**Skill and Competencies**

* Strong written and verbal communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence leaders at every level.
* Diplomacy in communicating needs and recommendations, with credibility that earns trust across functions.
* A proactive style that drives projects to completion despite obstacles.
* A collaborative team approach in all situations.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and workstreams at once.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office.

 **Additional Information**

*The salary range for this role is $195,000 - 225,000 annually*

Link Snacks provides a variety of benefits to eligible Team Members, including medical, dental and vision benefits, life and disability insurance, 401k participation, paid holidays, and paid time off.

**Equal Employment Opportunity Employer** 
We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation and gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

new_roles.title: Director of Quality
new_roles.description:
**Director of Quality**

**Location**

Carmel, IN • Memphis, TN • St. Louis, MO • Malden, MO • Peoria, IL • Other Illinois locations

**Leadership**

Directly manages at least two quality team members

**Travel**

Regular travel to manufacturing facilities and business locations, as needed

Weaver Popcorn is seeking a seasoned quality leader ready to step into a broader Director-level role. The Director of Quality provides strategic and operational leadership for food safety, quality assurance, regulatory compliance, audit readiness, and continuous improvement across the organization’s food manufacturing operations. This leader will strengthen and standardize quality systems, develop quality talent, and partner with plant and business leaders to ensure products consistently meet company, customer, certification, and regulatory requirements.

This is a hands-on leadership role for an experienced food manufacturing quality professional who can set direction while remaining actively engaged with plant teams, audits, investigations, corrective actions, and day-to-day execution.

**HOW WILL YOU HELP US GROW?**
==============================

**Quality & Food Safety Leadership**
------------------------------------

* Develop and lead the company’s quality and food safety strategy, priorities, policies, procedures, and performance expectations across manufacturing locations.
* Ensure quality assurance and food safety programs are effectively implemented, maintained, verified, and continuously improved.
* Establish and oversee grain and popcorn quality standards from grower receipt and bulk storage through processing, bagging, and shipment, ensuring consistent quality controls throughout the supply chain.
* Provide visible leadership on the manufacturing floor through routine plant engagement, risk reviews, verification activities, and follow-up on quality concerns.
* Build a culture of accountability, prevention, compliance, and continuous improvement across Quality, Operations, Supply Chain, Sales, and other partner functions.

**SQF, Audits & Regulatory Compliance**
---------------------------------------

* Lead and maintain SQF certification programs, including system ownership, audit preparation, certification readiness, corrective actions, and ongoing compliance.
* Plan, lead, and oversee internal, customer, certification, and regulatory audits of food manufacturing facilities.
* Ensure timely closure of audit findings, nonconformances, corrective and preventive actions, and related verification activities.
* Lead cross-functional Food Safety/HACCP, risk assessment, prerequisite program, and food quality teams.
* Monitor applicable food safety and quality requirements and translate them into practical operating standards and controls.
* Ensure effective quality controls for bulk grain storage, bin holds and releases, sampling, testing, and corn disposition prior to processing, including compliance with applicable phytosanitary requirements.

**Quality Management Systems**
------------------------------

* Own the effective use and continuous improvement of quality management system software, including document control, audits, corrective actions, training records, verification, and reporting.
* Standardize quality documentation, specifications, procedures, policies, records, and reporting across facilities.
* Use quality data, trend analysis, and leading and lagging indicators to identify risk, establish priorities, and improve performance.
* Ensure effective controls for ingredient sampling, product verification, environmental monitoring, sanitation verification, traceability, and other core quality programs.
* Provide oversight of corn testing and laboratory quality programs, including mycotoxin testing, internal and third-party sample testing, review of test results, and appropriate product disposition based on quality and food safety requirements.

**People Leadership & Cross-Functional Partnership**
----------------------------------------------------

* Lead, coach, and develop a quality team of at least two direct reports, with potential for broader team responsibility as the function grows.
* Set clear goals, define accountabilities, assess performance, strengthen technical capability, and create development plans for quality team members.
* Partner with Plant Managers and Operations leaders to resolve quality issues without compromising food safety, customer requirements, or regulatory compliance.
* Establish and enforce hold/release and product disposition standards, with authority to stop processing or bagging operations and place grain, ingredients, or finished product on hold when food safety or quality requirements are not met.
* Partner with Sales and Customer Service to respond to customer documentation requests, audits, samples, complaints, and quality-related inquiries.
* Lead investigations into customer complaints, product or process deviations, and recurring issues; ensure root cause analysis and sustainable corrective action.
* Oversee nonconforming material, product holds, rework, release, and disposition processes, partnering with Operations and suppliers to ensure timely resolution and prevent recurrence.
* Provide clear quality updates, risk assessments, recommendations, and performance reporting to senior leadership and other decision-makers.

**WHAT DO YOU NEED TO HAVE?**
=============================

* Bachelor's degree in food science, Food Safety, Microbiology, Chemistry, Biology, Engineering, or related fields.
* 8–10+ years of progressive quality or food safety experience in the food manufacturing industry.
* At least 5 years of people-management experience, including progressive supervisory and manager-level responsibility.
* Proven leadership of SQF certification programs and successful food manufacturing audits.
* Demonstrated knowledge of food safety principles, quality assurance procedures and policies, HACCP-based programs, risk assessment, corrective action, and preventive controls.
* Experience leading internal, customer, certification, and/or regulatory audits across food manufacturing environments.
* Hands-on experience with quality management system software and electronic quality records.
* Demonstrated ability to lead through influence, develop teams, manage competing priorities, and drive consistent execution across locations.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate quality risk and technical requirements to operational and executive audiences.
* Ability to travel regularly to manufacturing facilities and business locations, as needed.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience in grain, corn, popcorn, milling, ingredient, or related agricultural processing.
* SQF Practitioner experience and formal training in HACCP, PCQI, internal auditing, root cause analysis, or preventive controls.
* Experience supporting multiple manufacturing sites or standardizing quality systems across locations.
* Experience with supplier quality, customer complaint management, environmental monitoring, traceability, recall readiness, and food defense programs.

**WHAT DOES SUCCESS LOOK LIKE?**
================================

* Consistent audit and certification readiness across facilities.
* Stronger standardization and adoption of quality systems, procedures, and records.
* Timely, well-documented corrective action with verified effectiveness.
* Reduced recurrence of quality issues and customer complaints through disciplined root cause analysis.
* A capable, accountable quality team with clear goals and development plans.
* Credible, practical partnership with Operations and business leaders while maintaining independent quality judgment.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT & SCHEDULE**
===============================

This role operates across office and food manufacturing environments and requires regular presence in production areas. The typical schedule is Monday through Friday; however, the Director of Quality must be available outside normal business hours, including occasional evenings or weekends, when operational, audit, customer, or food safety needs require support. Regular travel is expected based on business needs.

**HOW WILL WE HELP YOU GROW?**
==============================

* Competitive compensation.
* Three weeks of paid time off in the first year.
* 401(k) plan with a company match of 100% of employee deferrals up to 10%.
* Health, vision, dental, life, and disability insurance beginning the first day of the month following 30 days of employment.
* Education reimbursement of up to $15,000 per year.

**EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY**
================================

Weaver Popcorn is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and associates. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, without regard to any status protected by applicable law.

*The role responsibilities are many, various, and not limited to those written in this document*

new_roles.description:
Stanton is the leading designer and supplier of decorative high quality self-branded carpet, custom fabricated rugs and hard surfaces. Stanton sells its products across the mid to high end residential as well as decorative commercial marketplaces. Stanton is rated #1 Favorite Area Rug Manufacturer for Style, Quality & Service and Top 5 Favorite Carpet Manufacturer among our customers in Floor Focus magazine.
 
 
Stanton is seeking a strategic and technical Director of Quality Control for our Calhoun GA location. This leader will drive the strategic development of a global supplier management program, ensuring that every sourced product meets clearly defined performance criteria and customer expectations. Through thorough vetting and continuous performance monitoring, you will minimize risk and foster a culture of quality excellence. This role is pivotal in upholding Stanton’s commitment to excellence, ensuring our entire product portfolio delivers uncompromised quality, integrity, and performance from the source to the end customer.
 
 
**Responsibilities Include: (but not limited to):** 
Strategic Quality Systems & Standards
 

* Develop, implement, and maintain a comprehensive Quality Management System (QMS) to track, report, and resolve quality issues across all product lines (carpets, rugs, and hard surfaces).
* Oversee internal and external audits to ensure strict adherence to industry regulations, ISO 9001 standards, and accrediting agency requirements.
* Drive risk avoidance through rigorous and thorough vetting of product quality, performance, and adherence to industry and global standards.

Global Supplier Management & Partnering
 

* Establish and maintain strategic relationships with vendors and manufacturers; monitor supplier performance and evaluate auditing processes to ensure global supply chain adherence.
* Develop and maintain data-driven supplier scorecards to measure and improve quality performance.
* Lead the vetting process for global product suppliers to ensure clearly defined fitness-for-use criteria.

Technical Integrity & Continuous Improvement
 

* Direct testing procedures and routine inspections to assess raw materials and finished products, ensuring durability, aesthetic, and functional specifications are met.
* Lead root-cause analyses and develop Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA) plans using Six Sigma or Lean methodologies to eliminate defects and improve efficiency.
* Analyze and report on quality metrics, trends, and performance to executive leadership and regulatory agencies as required.

Operational Oversight & Fiscal Responsibility
 

* Provide complete oversight and management of all downgraded inventory.
* Manage supplier chargebacks, ensuring financial accountability for quality failures.

Leadership & Organizational Culture
 

* Recruit, train, and manage Quality Control personnel, providing oversight of multiple QC inspectors daily.
* Conduct performance evaluations and foster a culture of quality, integrity, and performance excellence within the team.

**Qualifications Include:** 

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Quality Management, or a related industrial/scientific field required; Master’s degree preferred.
* 8 to 10+ years of progressive, hands-on quality control/assurance management experience.
* Strong understanding of machine and hand-woven carpet manufacturing process.
* Strong understanding of all hard surface manufacturing.
* Working knowledge of installation procedures.
* Proven expertise in quality control methodologies such as Six Sigma or Lean.
* Deep knowledge of standards such as ISO 9001 and experience with quality management software.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a track record of successful process improvement initiatives.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to train staff and liaise with external parties.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively as part of a strategic team.
* Physical Requirements: Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer; must be able to lift up to 15 pounds at times to inspect product samples.

new_roles.title: Manufacturing Execution Systems Senior Manager
new_roles.description:
Ready to join a global leader in air movement and ventilation? At Greenheck Group, joining our team means more than just starting a job, it’s joining an award-winning culture prioritizing your growth and development. Our unwavering commitment in supporting our team members both personally and professionally has earned us national recognition time and time again. As an innovative, environmentally responsible manufacturer of commercial HVAC systems, Greenheck Group designs and manufactures industry-leading air movement and ventilation solutions through our family of trusted brands. Our products are found in commercial, institutional, and industrial facilities worldwide, from schools and hospitals to factories and stadiums. Since 1947, we’ve proudly invested in our people and our communities, fostering innovation, leadership, and opportunity at every level. We are more than products, we are a team of inspired people doing extraordinary things.

As a Manufacturing Execution Systems Senior Manager for Greenheck Group you will own product strategy and delivery across Greenheck Group’s full manufacturing-systems portfolio — Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), maintenance management, machine integration, machine/production monitoring (MDC), and automation. You will serve as the senior product leader for Manufacturing Execution Systems, directly leading the MES functional lead team, owning the roadmap for the Critical Manufacturing platform consolidation, and establishing enterprise standards and consistency for manufacturing technology across Greenheck Group’s plants. You will operate as the critical connective link between enterprise manufacturing systems and the business, IT, Divisional Systems teams, and the broader Operational Systems/CoE community.

**WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING**

* Program Leadership: Own the product roadmap and delivery across the full manufacturing-systems portfolio — MES, maintenance management, machine integration, machine/production monitoring (MDC), and automation — across all Greenheck production sites. Lead the end-to-end roadmap for the Critical Manufacturing platform consolidation, replacing legacy custom integrations and MII applications across Greenheck's production sites. Coordinate cross-functional teams, allocate resources, and co-manage project timelines with Program Management. Drive accountability throughout execution and establish aggressive, results-oriented goals for the team.
* Divisional & CoE Alignment: Serve as the critical point of alignment between enterprise MES capabilities and divisional/plant-level execution — partnering closely with the business, IT, Divisional Systems teams, and the other Operational Systems/CoE groups (e.g., Operational Excellence, Machine Automation/MDC) to ensure enterprise standards translate into plant-level adoption and results.
* Team Leadership: Build and lead the MES functional lead team across the MES, maintenance, machine integration, monitoring, and automation domains.
* Change Leadership: Facilitate organizational change related to MES and manufacturing-systems adoption; communicate to create buy-in and promote system acceptance across plant floors.
* Standards and Consistency: Drive manufacturing-systems standards and consistency across Greenheck production sites through an MES steering committee and governance framework spanning MES, maintenance, machine integration, monitoring, and automation.
* Communication: Provide status updates on timeline, cost, and risk to the Operational Systems and OT Executive Steering Committees; communicate with team, stakeholders, and senior/executive leaders.
* Strategic Planning: Set the vision and develop and execute a comprehensive manufacturing-systems strategy aligned with organizational goals; identify opportunities for process improvement, efficiency gains, and cost reduction across MES, maintenance, machine integration, monitoring, and automation.
* Collaboration: Work closely with the Sr Manager, ERP and Program/Project Management on shared roadmap, resourcing, and delivery dependencies; partner with external resources to ensure manufacturing systems align with business objectives.
* Best Practices: Stay current on MES, automation, and manufacturing-technology trends and bring forward platform recommendations.

**WHAT YOU SHOULD HAVE AS A MANUFACTURING EXECUTION SYSTEMS SENIOR MANAGER**

* 4 Year / bachelor’s degree in engineering, information systems, business, or a related field required
* Graduate Degree in engineering, information systems, or related field preferred
* 4-6 years of relevant work experience in MES implementation, project management or related fields required
* Strong understanding of manufacturing processes and production environments required
* Certification in project management preferred
* Experience with MES systems and their integration with ERP preferred
* 80/20 thinking
* Manufacturing experience and credibility
* Strong team building and leadership
* Systems and technology savvy
* Strategic thinking and leadership
* Action-oriented

**SOME THINGS WE THINK YOU SHOULD KNOW**

* Travel of 10 to 25% will be required for this role.
* This is an on-site role at our Schofield, WI location.

**COMPENSATION & BENEFITS**

Greenheck Group takes pride in providing competitive total compensation along with a comprehensive benefits package as part of our total rewards program. The compensation for this role includes base salary along with the opportunity to earn additional variable compensation based on achieving specific performance metrics. The starting base pay range for this position is $160,353 - $198,083 and may vary based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and performance.

 

With best-in-class benefits, you can be the best you, and together, we can be the best in the industry. Visit our **Perks & Benefits page** for more information on these offerings:

 

* Health & Family Support
* Financial Security
* Learning & Development
* Rewards & Recognition
* Wellbeing & Mental Health
* Work-Life Balance
* Fun Perks

**SPECIAL NOTATION**

The preceding statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people in this position. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills. The Employer retains the right to change or assign other duties to this position.

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS**

Work is performed in an office environment and requires the ability to operate standard office equipment, such as a computer and phone. Sedentary work. Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally and/or negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects. Repetitive motion. Substantial motions of the wrists, hands, and/or fingers. The person is required to have close visual acuity to perform an activity such as: preparing and analyzing data, and figures; transcribing; viewing a computer terminal; extensive reading. Occasional mobility required to attend in-person meetings and complete various office tasks.

**EEO STATEMENT**

We are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status.

**ACCOMMODATIONS REQUEST**

Greenheck Group complies with federal and state disability laws and makes reasonable accommodations for applicants and candidates with disabilities. To request an accommodation for the application or interview process, please email HR@greenheck.com with your name, job title, posting number, and requested accommodation.

**RECRUITING FRAUD ALERT**

At Greenheck Group, your personal information and online safety are our top priorities. Our recruiters will only direct candidates to apply through our official career page at https://greenheckgroup.com/careers/. We will never request payments, financial account details, or sensitive information such as Social Security numbers. If you’re unsure about the legitimacy of a message, please contact HR@greenheck.com for verification.

If you're looking for a place to grow while working with happy, enthusiastic, values-based people, you'll enjoy your career with us!

new_roles.title: Senior Manager Operations
new_roles.description:
Since 2018, Elevate Aircraft Seating has been enhancing the passenger experience through innovative aircraft seat design and manufacturing. With locations in California, Washington, and Germany we are guided by creativity, collaboration, and a shared commitment to quality.

We are looking for a skilled Senior Manager Operations to join our team in Santa Maria, CA. This is an on-site position based in Santa Maria, CA. We value teamwork, inclusivity, and continuous professional development, and we offer competitive benefits along with opportunities for growth.

**Export Control Requirements:**

**This position must meet U.S. export control compliance requirements. To meet U.S. export control compliance requirements, a “U.S. Person” as defined by 22 C.F.R. §120.62 is required. “U.S. Person” includes U.S. Citizen, U.S. National, lawful permanent resident, refugee, or asylee.**

**JOB SUMMARY**

The Senior Manager, Operations is responsible for leading and overseeing manufacturing operations and maintenance activities to ensure the achievement of safety, quality, delivery, productivity, and cost objectives. This role drives operational performance through effective resource planning, workforce development, and process optimization while supporting continuous improvement initiatives. Partnering cross-functionally, the Senior Manager implements operational strategies, promotes accountability, and ensures efficient manufacturing execution aligned with organizational and customer objectives.

**SUMMARY OF JOB DUTIES** - **Essential Functions****(Other duties and projects may be assigned or requested.)**

*Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions*

**Operational Leadership & Performance**

* Lead and oversee daily manufacturing operations and maintenance activities to achieve safety, quality, on-time delivery, productivity, labor efficiency, scrap reduction, and work-in-process (WIP) inventory objectives.
* Establish, monitor, and drive accountability for key operational performance indicators (KPIs), implementing corrective actions to address performance gaps.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives by identifying operational inefficiencies, collaborating with relevant stakeholders, and implementing improvements within manufacturing operations.

**Production Planning & Execution**

* Oversee all phases of manufacturing operations to ensure production activities comply with established procedures, quality standards, and approved manufacturing processes.
* Plan, coordinate, and optimize departmental activities, production schedules, and resource allocation to meet customer requirements and business objectives.
* Evaluate production capacity, workforce requirements, and operational constraints to ensure effective utilization of labor, equipment, and manufacturing resources.

**People Leadership & Workforce Development**

* Lead, develop, and manage production and associated functional teams, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and operational excellence.
* Oversee workforce planning, recruitment, onboarding, training, and employee development to maintain operational readiness.
* Establish performance expectations, evaluate employee performance, and partner with Human Resources on coaching, employee relations, corrective actions, and performance management.

**Quality, Safety & Regulatory Compliance**

* Ensure manufacturing operations adhere to established Quality Management System (QMS) requirements, AS9100 standards, applicable aerospace regulations, and internal policies and procedures.
* Promote a culture of safety, quality, and compliance by ensuring employees are appropriately trained and consistently follow established manufacturing procedures.

**Financial Management & Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Manage departmental budgets, monitor operational expenditures, and implement cost-control measures to support financial objectives.
* Partner with Supply Chain, Planning, Quality, Engineering, Program Management, and other stakeholders to resolve operational challenges, align production priorities, and meet customer delivery commitments.

**Other**

* Maintain a safe, secure and legal work environment, adhering to all Company policies and procedures.
* Protect the confidentiality of the Company’s information and products.
* Contribute to team efforts by performing other job-related duties and projects as assigned or requested.

**GENERAL QUALIFICATIONS – Education, Knowledge, and Experience**

**Education**:

* High School Diploma or GED equivalent required.
* Associate degree, technical/trade certification, or bachelor’s degree in Manufacturing, Engineering, Operations Management, Business Administration, or a related field preferred.

**Experience**:

* 10+ years of progressive experience in manufacturing operations, including 5+ years in a leadership role overseeing production teams, operational performance, and manufacturing processes.
* Demonstrated success managing manufacturing operations in a complex, quality-driven production environment, with a focus on improving safety, quality, delivery, productivity, and cost performance.
* Proven ability to lead supervisors or managers, develop high-performing teams, and drive operational improvements across multiple manufacturing functions.

**Skills**:

* Strong leadership and people management skills, with the ability to develop teams, establish accountability, and manage employee performance.
* Proficiency in manufacturing operations, production planning, workforce allocation, and capacity management.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to interpret operational KPIs and implement effective corrective actions.
* Knowledge of budget management, cost control, and resource optimization within a manufacturing environment.
* Effective communication, organizational, and cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and support business objectives.

**Preferred Skills/Experience:**

* Experience in aerospace manufacturing, aircraft interiors, or other highly regulated manufacturing environments, with knowledge of AS9100 and Quality Management Systems (QMS).
* Familiarity with Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, or other continuous improvement methodologies.
* Experience utilizing Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems and manufacturing performance reporting tools.

**Other**:

* Extended or irregular hours may be required.
* Must be authorized to work in the United States.
* Elevate Aircraft Seating is an “at-will” employer; employment is at the mutual consent of both the employee and the employer, and may be terminated at will for any reason, with or without cause, at any time during employment with the Company.
* As business conditions warrant a change in the operating necessities of the Company, all employees are expected to react productively, handle other essential tasks assigned now or in the future.
* Tasks may vary slightly based on products produced at a division.
* Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**CERTIFICATES AND LICENSE**

* N/A

**SUPERVISION PROVIDED TO THE POSITION**

* Direction is provided for assignments in terms of desired outcome (goals), timing and budget.? Work is reviewed or measured in terms of meeting organizational objectives and schedules.

**LEADERSHIP RESPONSIBILITY**

* Provides leadership, coaching, and direction to operational personnel to achieve organizational goals, operational performance objectives, and budgetary targets. Responsible for employee development, performance management, and building organizational capability.

**PROBLEM SOLVING**

* Develop and implement solutions to complex operational challenges that are consistent with organizational objectives and established business practices.

**LANGUAGE SKILLS**

* Ability to communicate effectively in English, both verbally and in writing.

**COMPENSATION & BENEFITS** 
*Elevate Aircraft Seating offers competitive wages and benefits to recognize employees for their work. The base pay offered will vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, location, experience and take into account internal equity.*

**Salary Range Transparency:** $125,500 - $185,000

**Featured Benefits:**

* Generous 401(K) matching with immediate eligibility and vesting
* 3 weeks of Paid Time Off
* 12 paid holidays
* Affordable health care plans for yourself and your family
* And so much more!

**Other Perks:**

* Supportive workplace environment with a team-oriented culture
* Potential for growth within organization

new_roles.title: Senior Plant Manager - Peach Tree City, GA
new_roles.description:
**WHY DO WE NEED YOU?**

The Senior Plant Manager is responsible for the safe, efficient, and profitable operation of our CertainTeed Roofing manufacturing facility in Peachtree City. Reporting to the Senior Director of Regional Operations, this role provides overall leadership for safety, quality, production, cost, delivery, people development, and sustainability performance.

You will set the vision and culture for the site, align daily operations with business strategy, and lead continuous improvement and long term plant performance. Success in this role requires sound judgment, strong business and people leadership, and the ability to balance workforce engagement, customer expectations, regulatory compliance, and community responsibility.

 **IS THIS JOB FOR YOU?**

**What you will do:**

* Lead all aspects of plant operations, including safety, production, maintenance, quality, logistics, engineering, and environmental performance.
* Build and sustain a strong safety culture where health and safety are integrated into daily decisions and operations.
* Deliver plant performance goals across safety, quality, service, cost, productivity, and profitability.
* Own the plant operating budget, forecasting, cost management, and long range planning.
* Drive continuous improvement through Lean Manufacturing, reliability, process optimization, problem solving, and operational excellence.
* Lead change initiatives and translate business strategy into actionable plant priorities and measurable results.
* Build and develop a high performing leadership team through coaching, feedback, succession planning, and employee development.
* Partner cross functionally with Sales, Supply Chain, R&D, Product Management, and other key stakeholders to support customer and business needs.
* Provide leadership for major capital projects and other strategic plant initiatives.

**What you bring:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent experience, required.
* 10+ years of progressive production or operations management experience.
* 5 to 7 years of experience at the Production Manager or Plant Superintendent level preferred.
* Master’s degree in Engineering, Business, or Operations Management preferred.
* Strong knowledge of production planning, scheduling, supply chain, budgeting, forecasting, and cost control.
* Experience with Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, WCM, or similar continuous improvement methodologies.
* Knowledge of quality management systems, equipment reliability, process optimization, OSHA requirements, and safety practices.
* Strong leadership, communication, problem solving, and change management skills.
* Ability to travel domestically approximately 20% of the time.

 
**A LITTLE MORE ABOUT US**

Through the responsible development of innovative and sustainable building products, CertainTeed, headquartered in Malvern, Pennsylvania, has helped shape the building products industry for more than 110 years. Founded in 1904 as General Roofing Manufacturing Company, the company’s slogan, “Quality Made Certain, Satisfaction Guaranteed,” inspired the name CertainTeed. Today, CertainTeed is a leading North American brand of exterior and interior building products, including roofing, siding, trim, insulation, drywall, and ceilings. CertainTeed is a subsidiary of Saint-Gobain, one of the world’s largest and oldest building products companies.

 **LEGAL STATEMENT**

Saint-Gobain provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, amnesty, or status as a covered veteran in accordance with applicable federal, state and local laws. Saint-Gobain is an equal opportunity employer of individuals with disabilities and supports the hiring of veterans.

Applicants for roles based in Washington state or remote roles that would be worked from Washington state are encouraged to direct any concerns regarding the state’s Pay Transparency laws to the SGNA HR Compliance team at SGNA\_HR\_Compliance@saint-gobain.com.

 **BENEFITS IN JOINING US**

Saint-Gobain aims to deliver a comprehensive Total Rewards package that supports employees’ wellbeing and helps improve daily life for employees and their families. Be Well. Be You brings together inclusive programs and meaningful resources that support physical, emotional, financial, and social wellbeing. Employees have flexibility to choose the benefits that best fit their individual needs.

Health and wellbeing

* Medical, prescription drug, vision, and dental insurance
* Health Savings Account and Flexible Spending Account options
* LiveWell Wellness Program
* Employee Assistance Program
* Paid time off and paid parental leave

Retirement and protection

* 401(k) with company match and Retirement Accumulation Plan cash balance pension plan
* Company provided life insurance, accidental death and dismemberment insurance, and short term disability
* Voluntary employee and dependent life insurance, long term disability, critical illness insurance, and accident insurance

Additional benefits

* Commuter benefits
* Group legal and identity theft protection
* Auto and home insurance
* Pet insurance and discounts
* Back up child and elder care
* PerkSpot Employee Discount Program
* Volunteer Day
